messages.stats.graph.actions.title: Tuning suggestions
messages.stats.graph.advisory.action: Action rule: high clustering needs cross-circle suggestions; low reach needs bridge users and mixed events.
messages.stats.graph.advisory.body: This is social topology, not click analytics. It shows whether people are connected through useful bridges, weak ties, and repeat encounters.
messages.stats.graph.advisory.clustering: Clustering shows whether circles are healthy or too closed.
messages.stats.graph.advisory.reach: 2-hop reach shows how much of the city is reachable through friends of friends.
messages.stats.graph.advisory.recurring: Recurring edges show real community forming.
messages.stats.graph.advisory.title: How to read it
messages.stats.graph.advisory.weak.ties: Weak ties open discovery beyond direct friends.
messages.stats.graph.help.actions.body: Use the state as an operating guide: high clustering means add cross-circle suggestions, low reach means prioritize bridge users, low weak ties means show new faces, and low recurring ties means create repeatable events.
messages.stats.graph.help.actions.title: What to do with it
messages.stats.graph.help.bridges.body: A bridge person connects otherwise separate circles. If bridges disappear, the graph can fragment even when total activity looks fine.
messages.stats.graph.help.bridges.title: Bridge people
messages.stats.graph.help.clustering.body: Clustering shows how closed the local circles are. Too high can create cliques; too low can mean people do not feel belonging.
messages.stats.graph.help.clustering.title: Clustering
messages.stats.graph.help.edges.body: Users are nodes and edges are real connection evidence: ratings, affinity, invitations, event overlap, or repeated encounters.
messages.stats.graph.help.edges.title: Users and edges
messages.stats.graph.help.evolution.body: Graph evolution shows whether new, weak, and recurring edges are growing over time. This is the living health of the community.
messages.stats.graph.help.evolution.title: Graph evolution
messages.stats.graph.help.health.body: Graph health combines reachability, bridge coverage, weak ties, clustering, recurring ties, and edge quality into one operating score.
messages.stats.graph.help.health.title: Graph health
messages.stats.graph.help.intro: This is not classic engagement analytics. It explains the shape of the social network: who connects circles, how far discovery reaches, and whether first meetings become community.
messages.stats.graph.help.reach.body: 2-hop reach asks how much of a city can be reached through a friend of a friend. High reach means discovery can grow without everybody knowing everybody.
messages.stats.graph.help.reach.title: 2-hop reach
messages.stats.graph.help.recurring.body: Recurring ties show repeated interaction. They are usually a stronger community signal than one-off clicks or first meetings.
messages.stats.graph.help.recurring.title: Recurring ties
messages.stats.graph.help.title: How to read the social graph
messages.stats.graph.help.weak.body: Weak ties are light connections outside the close circle. They are valuable because they open new people, events, and communities.
messages.stats.graph.help.weak.title: Weak ties
messages.stats.graph.insight.bridge-risk: There are not enough bridge people for the current graph size. Mixed events and inside-network introductions should help clusters connect without forcing random exposure.
messages.stats.graph.insight.cliques: The graph is becoming clique-heavy. Suggestions should lean toward weak ties and cross-community events so discovery does not collapse into closed circles.
messages.stats.graph.insight.closed: The graph has too few weak ties. Outside-network and friends-of-friends suggestions should get more room until discovery opens up.
messages.stats.graph.insight.cold: Not enough graph evidence yet. Keep collecting ratings, event attendance, and invitations before trusting the social graph signals.
messages.stats.graph.insight.fragmented: Reachability is low, so users sit in separated islands. Prioritize bridge users, mixed events, and suggestions that connect nearby communities.
messages.stats.graph.insight.healthy: The graph has useful bridges, enough weak ties, and stable recurring edges. Keep the current balance between belonging and discovery.

messages.stats.graph.map.community.legend: Big circles = user circles; number shows people in that circle.

messages.guide.activities.rates.primary.trigger.d: The selected section changes the list and its filters. Badges count the activity in each section, so you can see where items are waiting.
messages.guide.activities.rates.primary.rates.des: Shows your rating activity. The rating group separates sent, received and mutual interest; its count belongs to the selected group.
messages.guide.activities.rates.primary.chats.des: Switches to conversations and their context filters. Rating groups stay separate from chat activity.
messages.guide.activities.rates.primary.events.de: Switches to event activity, with event-specific categories and date views. It does not change a rating or join an event.
messages.guide.activities.rates.rate.trigger.desc: Selects whose interest you are reviewing: yours, other people’s or mutual ratings. The badge counts profiles in that group.
messages.guide.activities.rates.rate.social.label: Community ratings
messages.guide.activities.rates.rate.social.descr: Includes community suggestions alongside individual ratings. This changes the source of the recommendations you review.
messages.guide.activities.rates.rate.individual.g: Profiles you have rated appear here. This records your outgoing interest; it does not mean the other person has rated you back.
messages.guide.activities.rates.rate.individual.r: People who rated you appear here. Their interest is incoming; you can inspect their profiles before deciding how to respond.
messages.guide.activities.rates.rate.individual.m: View people you have rated who have also rated you. The badge shows the number of mutual ratings.
Keeps profiles of people marked as met together, so you can return to those connections after discovery.
messages.guide.activities.rates.rate.pair.given.d: Shows pair suggestions you sent to other people. This tracks your recommendations separately from your own individual interest.
messages.guide.activities.rates.rate.pair.receive: Shows pair suggestions other people sent you. A recommendation is their suggestion, not an automatic mutual match.
messages.guide.activities.rates.secondary.trigger: Sorting changes which cards appear first while retaining the selected rating group. Choose time or relevance to suit what you want to review.
Places recent activity first, so newer interactions are easier to find. It changes order, not the recorded ratings.
messages.guide.activities.rates.secondary.relevan: Prioritizes relevance instead of time, helping you review stronger matches earlier. Your saved ratings remain unchanged.
messages.guide.activities.rates.secondary.past.de: Focuses on earlier activity when you want to revisit it. The selected rating group still determines which profiles belong in the list.
messages.guide.activities.rates.view.trigger.desc: Grouping changes how the list is divided into days, weeks, months or distance ranges. It does not change ratings or group membership.
messages.guide.activities.rates.view.month.label: Month
messages.guide.activities.rates.view.month.descri: Groups activity into months for a wider time overview. Calendar arrows move the period while your filters remain active.
messages.guide.activities.rates.view.week.label: Week
messages.guide.activities.rates.view.week.descrip: Group cards by week to compare activity over time. Use the calendar arrows to move between weeks.
messages.guide.activities.rates.view.day.label: Day
messages.guide.activities.rates.view.day.descript: Groups activity by day, making a particular date easier to revisit. Your selected rating group and sorting still apply.
messages.guide.activities.rates.view.distance.des: Groups profiles by distance so nearby people are easier to compare. Distance changes the grouping, not the interest already recorded.
messages.guide.activities.rates.fullscreen.label: Fullscreen view
messages.guide.activities.rates.fullscreen.descri: Gives the cards more screen space for comparison. Leaving fullscreen returns to the same rating list and filters.
messages.guide.activities.rates.score.label: Rating score
messages.guide.activities.rates.score.description: The given and received directions are separate. In the unfiltered Work list each campaign contributes equally to the person average: 8 and 9 become 8.5. Open a campaign’s Ratings action to see only that campaign.
messages.guide.activities.rates.pagination.prev.d: Move to the previous cards or calendar period in the selected view. Your group and sorting stay active.
messages.guide.activities.rates.pagination.next.d: Move to the next cards or calendar period in the selected view. Your group and sorting stay active.
messages.guide.activities.rates.pair.resize.label: Resize pair cards
messages.guide.activities.rates.pair.resize.descr: Dragging changes how much space each person’s card gets. It only adjusts the comparison layout; neither profile nor rating changes.
messages.guide.activities.rates.related.profile.d: Opens the profile related to this card, so you can inspect the person connected to the activity. This is useful when an activity card refers to a person other than its main profile.
messages.guide.activities.rates.image.switch.desc: The photo is divided into one clickable section per image: three photos give thirds, four give quarters. Tap a section to select that photo without opening a popup.
messages.guide.activities.rates.profile.label: Details and history
messages.guide.activities.rates.profile.descripti: In Work Ratings, the eye opens the campaign interaction history on Details. The header can switch to the person’s Organizer profile.
messages.guide.activities.rates.close.label: Close activities
messages.guide.activities.rates.close.description: Closes the Activities popup and returns to the screen behind it; it dismisses this view only. Your place in the underlying screen remains where it was.
messages.guide.activities.rates.title: Activity ratings guide
Switch between transport, accommodation, supplies, and tickets. The count helps you see what is available in each category before opening its list.
messages.guide.assets.accommodation.asset.list.de: Each card summarizes a place, its location, and capacity. Open it to review availability or use its actions to manage requests and event assignments.
messages.guide.assets.accommodation.asset.pending: This toggle filters the list to assets with requests that still need attention. Its badge shows the pending count, and switching it off restores all assets.
messages.guide.assets.asset.category.description: Choose the category that best describes this item. The category determines where the asset appears and which details people use to understand it.
messages.guide.assets.asset.category.label: Asset category
messages.guide.assets.asset.photos.description: Add or change photos so people can recognize the asset before making a request. The images are shown on its card and help distinguish similar items.
messages.guide.assets.asset.photos.label: Asset photos
messages.guide.assets.asset.title.description: Give the asset a clear name that people can recognize in lists and event requests. A useful title makes it easier to choose the right item later.
messages.guide.assets.asset.title.label: Asset name
messages.guide.assets.supplies.asset.filter.trigg: Switch between transport, accommodation, supplies, and tickets. The count helps you see what is available in each category before opening its list.
messages.guide.assets.supplies.asset.list.descrip: Each card shows a supply item and its available quantity. Open a card for details, or use its actions to manage requests and assign supplies to an event.
messages.guide.assets.supplies.asset.list.label: Supplies
messages.guide.assets.supplies.asset.pending.desc: This toggle filters the list to assets with requests that still need attention. Its badge shows the pending count, and switching it off restores all assets.
messages.guide.assets.tickets.asset.filter.trigge: Switch between transport, accommodation, supplies, and tickets. The count helps you see what is available in each category before opening its list.
messages.guide.assets.tickets.ticket.list.descrip: Open a ticket to show its QR code or check-in status. The code is used at the event entrance, and its status indicates whether it was already used.
messages.guide.assets.tickets.ticket.list.label: Event tickets
messages.guide.assets.tickets.ticket.order.trigge: Choose upcoming or past tickets to find the relevant event faster. This changes the list order, while each ticket still opens its own code and status.
messages.guide.assets.transport.asset.filter.trig: Switch between transport, accommodation, supplies, and tickets. The count helps you see what is available in each category before opening its list.
messages.guide.assets.transport.asset.list.descri: Each card summarizes a vehicle and its availability. Open a card to review details or use its actions to manage requests and event assignments.
messages.guide.assets.transport.asset.list.label: Transport assets
messages.guide.assets.transport.asset.pending.des: This toggle filters the list to assets with requests that still need attention. Its badge shows the pending count, and switching it off restores all assets.
messages.guide.chats.activity.list.description: Each row opens a conversation or its available actions. The list follows your selected context, so changing the filter above changes which chats appear.
messages.guide.chats.activity.list.label: Conversations
messages.guide.chats.chat.context.trigger.descrip: Filter conversations by their context, such as events, groups, or support. This narrows the list so you can find the relevant chat faster.
messages.guide.chats.chat.context.trigger.label: Conversation context
messages.guide.chats.primary.trigger.description: Switch between ratings, conversations, and events. The badges show matching items, and choosing a section changes the list below.
messages.guide.chats.primary.trigger.label: Activity sections
messages.guide.common.close.description: Close this popup when you are done here. The guide ends with this screen, while the parent view stays open if the app keeps it underneath.
messages.guide.common.close.label: Close this popup
messages.guide.contacts.contact.search.descriptio: Enter a name to narrow the contacts list. This is useful when you have saved many people and want to open one profile or contact method quickly.
messages.guide.contacts.contact.search.label: Search contacts
Choose a group to show a specific set of contacts. Switching groups changes the list, while the search term can further narrow the visible people.
messages.guide.contacts.contacts.list.description: Contact cards provide shortcuts to profiles, conversations, and saved contact methods. Their badges and actions depend on the person and the details available.
messages.guide.contacts.contacts.list.label: Saved contacts
messages.guide.event.editor.event.images.descript: Add photos that show what the event is about. They appear on event cards and help invitees recognize the event before opening its details.
messages.guide.event.editor.event.images.label: Event photos
messages.guide.event.editor.event.options.descrip: These controls change important event settings, such as visibility and structure. Review them before saving so the event behaves as you intend.
messages.guide.event.editor.event.options.label: Event options
messages.guide.event.editor.event.title.descripti: Choose a name that tells invitees which event this is. It appears on cards and in related views, making the event easier to find and distinguish.
messages.guide.event.editor.event.title.label: Event name
messages.guide.event.feedback.event.feedback.filt: Filter feedback by its current state to focus on items that need review or already have a response. The selection changes which cards appear below.
messages.guide.event.feedback.feedback.list.descr: Review the feedback cards and their status badges. Open a card to respond or inspect its details; organizers can also review the collected results.
messages.guide.event.feedback.feedback.list.label: Event feedback
messages.guide.events.activity.list.description: Browse event cards and open an event to see its details. The selected category above controls the cards shown here and helps you focus on what matters.
messages.guide.events.activity.list.label: Events
messages.guide.events.event.scope.trigger.descrip: Choose which events to show, such as invitations, drafts, or active events. Counts on the options help you see where attention is needed.
messages.guide.events.event.scope.trigger.label: Event categories
messages.guide.events.primary.trigger.description: Switch between ratings, conversations, and events. The badges show matching items, and choosing a section changes the list below.
messages.guide.events.primary.trigger.label: Activity sections
messages.guide.home.game.cards.description: These cards show people in your current discovery view. Badges summarize activity, while the card controls open photos, profiles, and rating actions.
messages.guide.home.game.cards.label: Suggested people
messages.guide.home.game.header.description: Use these shortcuts to choose profile preferences, filter suggestions, or open your rating history.
messages.guide.home.game.header.label: Home and activity
messages.guide.profile.editor.profile.actions.des: Export your calendar or open account connections. Available shortcuts depend on your account role.
messages.guide.profile.editor.profile.form.descri: Complete the sections that describe you and choose how details are shared. Saving these changes updates the profile people see across the app.
messages.guide.profile.editor.profile.form.label: Profile details
messages.guide.profile.editor.profile.photo.descr: The pencil opens your photo slots for upload, replacement and removal. Closing that popup returns to the draft; Save profile persists the changes.
messages.guide.profile.editor.profile.photo.label: Manage your profile photos
messages.guide.profile.view.profile.card.descript: The card brings together the person’s photos and basic introduction. Use its photo controls to browse images before reading the detailed information below.
messages.guide.profile.view.profile.card.label: Profile card
messages.guide.profile.view.profile.details.descr: This section shows profile details and any visibility badges attached to them. Those indicators help explain why some information may be visible only to certain people.
messages.guide.profile.view.profile.details.label: Personal details
messages.guide.profile.view.profile.experience.de: Review the person’s experience entries to learn more about their background. Each entry adds context to the profile without changing its basic details.
messages.guide.home.game.home-mode.label: Discovery mode
messages.guide.home.game.home-mode.description: Choose how people are matched before you review cards. Changing this mode changes the suggestions and available search fields.
messages.guide.home.game.home-mode.single.label: Individual profiles
messages.guide.home.game.home-mode.single.descrip: Browse one profile at a time and compare it with your preferences. Use this when you want to decide separately for each person.
messages.guide.home.game.home-mode.friends-in-com: Find suggestions connected through mutual friends. The extra search fields help narrow the list to people in the same social circle.
messages.guide.home.game.home-mode.separated-frie: Browse people connected to your existing network. This view helps you discover profiles through relationships you already share.
messages.guide.home.game.home-mode.outside-networ: Explore profiles beyond your current connections. Use this view when you want to broaden the people you can discover.
messages.guide.home.game.home-filter.label: Profile filters
messages.guide.home.game.home-filter.description: Set interests and profile criteria to focus the suggestions you see. The filter badge shows when criteria are active, so you can tell why the list is narrower.
messages.guide.home.game.home-history.label: Rating history
messages.guide.home.game.home-history.description: The Ratings shortcut on Home opens your rating activity. From there, the rating group menu lets you review likes you sent, received, matched, or marked as met.
messages.guide.home.game.rating-input.label: Affinity slider
messages.guide.home.game.rating-input.description: Move the slider from 1 to 10 to express how strongly this profile fits you. The chosen value is saved when you press Go.
messages.guide.home.game.image-switch.label: Switch profile photos
messages.guide.home.game.image-switch.description: The photo is divided into one clickable section per image: three photos give thirds, four give quarters. Tap a section to select that photo without opening a popup.
messages.guide.home.game.profile.label: Open full profile
messages.guide.home.game.profile.description: Use the eye button to see the person’s profile, experience, and other details. Your current discovery list stays available behind the profile popup.
messages.guide.home.game.pagination-next.label: Save and go to the next profile
messages.guide.home.game.pagination-next.descript: Go is a button: it saves the selected affinity value and advances to the next suggested profile. Adjust the slider before pressing it.
messages.guide.activities.rates.rating-input.desc: Move the slider from 1 to 10 to change your rating for the visible person or pair. Use Save to record it. A read-only rating cannot be adjusted.
This badge opens the person connected to the activity card. It gives you the context behind the rating before you continue with the list.
messages.guide.activities.rates.card-badge-end.de: This badge opens the people or members related to the activity. Use it to review who is involved without losing your place in the rating list.
messages.guide.activities.rates.card-actions.desc: Actions belong to this activity card and depend on your access. The guide opens the menu to explain them without executing an action.
messages.guide.events.card-badge-start.label: Event host badge
messages.guide.events.card-badge-start.descriptio: Open the host profile from the event card to check who is organizing it. This can help you decide whether the event and its community are relevant to you.
messages.guide.events.card-badge-end.label: Event members badge
messages.guide.events.card-badge-end.description: Open the member list from this badge to review attendees and available participation details. Any pending count signals requests that still need attention.
messages.guide.events.card-actions.label: Event card actions
messages.guide.events.card-actions.description: Open the event’s action menu to view the actions available for this event and your role. Use it to continue with management, sharing, or participation tasks.
messages.guide.events.pagination-prev.label: Previous period
messages.guide.events.pagination-prev.description: Show the previous week or month in the calendar. The selected event group and filters stay active.
messages.guide.events.pagination-next.label: Next period
messages.guide.events.pagination-next.description: Show the next week or month in the calendar. The selected event group and filters stay active.
messages.guide.chats.chat-list.label: Conversation list
messages.guide.chats.chat-list.description: Choose a conversation to open its messages and continue where you left off. The surrounding filters determine which conversations are included here.
messages.guide.chats.chat-search.label: Find a conversation
messages.guide.chats.chat-search.description: Search for a person or conversation when the list is long. This narrows the visible results without changing or deleting any messages.
messages.guide.chats.chat-compose.label: Write a message
messages.guide.chats.chat-compose.description: Enter your message here and send it to the open conversation. Replies, shared items, and any selected context stay attached to this chat.
messages.guide.chats.chat-send.label: Send message
messages.guide.chats.chat-send.description: Send the text you have written to the current conversation. Check the recipient and context first, since sending makes the message visible to its participants.
messages.guide.chats.chat-actions.label: Message actions
messages.guide.chats.chat-actions.description: Open a message menu to reply, react, or use other available actions. These controls apply to one message, keeping the rest of the conversation unchanged.
messages.guide.profile.editor.profile-name.label: Profile basics
messages.guide.profile.editor.profile-name.descri: Review your name and core profile details so people can recognize you. Accurate information makes your profile and event introductions clearer.
Choose who can see your profile and participate in discovery. This setting affects how your information is shown across matching and community screens.
Choose interests that describe what you enjoy. Their visibility setting controls who can see them.
messages.guide.profile.editor.profile-save.label: Save profile changes
messages.guide.profile.editor.profile-save.descri: Save your edits when the sections are ready. The updated information is then used by your profile view and the surfaces where others discover you.
messages.guide.profile.editor.profile-language.de: Select the languages you speak. They appear in your profile and can be used when filtering people.
Move through the available photos to see more of the person’s profile. The selected photo changes the image in this view, not the person’s saved profile.
messages.guide.profile.view.profile-contact.label: Contact options
messages.guide.profile.view.profile-contact.descr: Review the contact methods the person chose to share. Use an available option only when you want to continue the conversation outside this profile view.
messages.guide.profile.view.profile-related.label: Related activity
messages.guide.profile.view.profile-related.descr: Open related activity to understand where this profile appeared and what connects you. This adds context before you return to the original list.
messages.guide.profile.view.profile-close.label: Close profile details
messages.guide.profile.view.profile-close.descrip: Close this profile popup to return to the screen that opened it. Closing the guide itself does not close the profile or change its information.
messages.guide.contacts.contact-add.label: Add a contact
messages.guide.contacts.contact-add.description: Save a person as a contact to make future conversations and profile access easier. Contact status is managed separately from ratings and event participation.
messages.guide.contacts.contact-card-start.label: Contact profile badge
messages.guide.contacts.contact-card-start.descri: Open the contact’s profile from the card to review shared details. This is useful when you need to confirm who a saved contact is.
messages.guide.contacts.contact-card-actions.desc: Open the contact menu to see available actions such as editing or removing the shortcut. These actions manage your saved relationship, not the person’s profile.
messages.guide.contacts.contact-list.label: Saved contact cards
messages.guide.contacts.contact-list.description: Browse the saved people and open the one you need. Search and group filters help you find a contact without changing their stored details.
messages.guide.notifications.notification-workspa: Switch the workspace whose updates you want to review. Notification rows and counters then reflect that selected community context.
Choose whether to focus on unread notifications or include the full history. This makes it easier to catch up first and browse older updates later.
messages.guide.notifications.notification-attenti: Mute or restore attention alerts without deleting notifications. The setting changes how the app draws your attention while the list remains available.
messages.guide.notifications.notification-list.de: Open a notification to continue to the related conversation, event, group, or request. Read status and available actions are shown with each item so you can decide what to handle.
messages.guide.notifications.notification-row-act: Use the row menu to mark an item read or open its destination. This helps you clear handled updates while preserving the underlying conversation or event.
messages.guide.payment.history.payment-history-fi: Switch between all payments, expenses, and income to focus the history on one type of transaction. The selected filter affects the rows and totals you review.
messages.guide.payment.history.payment-history-to: Open the currency summary to compare incoming and outgoing amounts. This gives context for the individual records shown below.
messages.guide.payment.history.payment-history-li: Review payments and refunds in date order. Open a row menu for the transaction’s available details and actions.
messages.guide.payment.history.record-cash.label: Record cash payment
messages.guide.payment.history.record-cash.descri: Record a cash transaction so it appears alongside other payment history. Enter the correct amount and context because this creates a financial record for the account.
messages.guide.payment.history.open-cards.label: Manage payment methods
messages.guide.payment.history.open-cards.descrip: Open saved payment methods to add, review, or update a card. These methods are used by eligible checkout flows and are managed separately from past transactions.
messages.guide.profile.impressions.impressions-ho: Review the traits and feedback associated with the person as an organizer. These signals summarize how event participants experienced their hosting.
messages.guide.profile.impressions.impressions-me: Switch to the attendee view to see feedback from event hosts. The two roles are kept separate so each set of impressions has the right context.
messages.guide.profile.impressions.impressions-ph: Move between profile photos while reviewing these impressions. The carousel changes only the displayed image and keeps the feedback in view.
messages.guide.profile.impressions.impressions-cl: Return to the screen that opened this summary when you are finished. Closing the guide leaves the impressions popup open for further review.
messages.guide.community.groups.bucket.trigger.de: Switch between groups you host, joined groups, pending requests, invitations, and the archive. The selected section changes which group cards and actions are available.
messages.guide.community.groups.sort.trigger.desc: Choose recent activity or distance to change the order of group cards. Sorting helps you find an active or nearby community without changing membership.
messages.guide.community.groups.actions.trigger.d: Open the actions menu to start a group or browse communities you can join. Creating changes group data; exploring only narrows the communities you see.
messages.guide.community.groups.group-list.label: Group cards
messages.guide.community.groups.group-list.descri: Open a card to review its community, membership, and activity. Card menus show the actions allowed by your role and the group’s current state.
Open the owner profile to understand who runs the community. This context can help you decide whether to request access or contact the organizer.
messages.guide.community.groups.card-badge-end.de: Review the people in a group and any pending membership activity. This helps you understand the community before joining or managing requests.
messages.guide.community.groups.card-actions.desc: Open the card menu to manage or review this group. The available actions depend on whether you host it, belong to it, or are still requesting access.
Choose a category to focus group discovery on communities with the interests you want. Selecting all restores the full set of discoverable groups.
messages.guide.community.groups.explore.sort.trig: Change the order between recently updated and nearby groups. This helps you decide which community to inspect first.
messages.guide.community.groups.explore.actions.t: Open the group actions to create a new community or return to your own group areas. Discovery itself does not join a group or send a request.
messages.guide.community.groups.explore.group-lis: Compare the community description, activity, and member badges before opening a group. Use the card actions to request membership when you are ready.
messages.guide.community.groups.explore.card-badg: Open the organizer profile to learn who created the group. This provides context before you decide whether to join its community.
Use the member badge to see the community behind the listing. Member and pending counts help you understand the group’s current activity.
messages.guide.community.groups.explore.card-acti: Explore group actions
Open the group menu to review or request access. The action available depends on the group’s visibility and your current membership.
messages.guide.community.feed.status.trigger.desc: Choose public, seen, or a moderation status to decide which posts appear. This helps you review your feed or focus on posts that need moderation.
messages.guide.community.feed.feed-list.label: Photo and event posts
messages.guide.community.feed.feed-list.descripti: Open a post to view its full image and linked event context. Scrolling through the feed keeps the current status filter in place.
messages.guide.community.feed.card-badge-start.de: Open the author profile to learn who shared this post. This can help you understand the people and events connected to the image.
messages.guide.community.feed.card-badge-end.desc: Open the post details or linked event from this badge. The destination keeps the image’s surrounding context available for review.
messages.guide.community.feed.card-actions.label: Post actions
messages.guide.community.feed.card-actions.descri: Open the post menu to follow its organizer or remove your own post. Only actions allowed for the current post and account are shown.
messages.guide.community.feed.add.label: Create a feed post
messages.guide.community.feed.add.description: Start a new post and choose the photos or event context to share. Review the selected content before publishing it to your feed.
messages.guide.events.followed.event-explore-filt: Narrow the event list by the preferences available on this screen. The filters help you focus on events from organizers you chose to follow.
messages.guide.events.followed.event-explore-orde: Choose the event order that matches what you want to find first. Sorting changes the sequence of cards without changing which organizers you follow.
messages.guide.events.followed.event-explore-view: Choose a calendar grouping to scan upcoming events by time period. The view makes a long list easier to browse while retaining its followed-only scope.
messages.guide.events.followed.event-list.label: Followed event cards
messages.guide.events.followed.event-list.descrip: Review details, organizers, and available places on each event card. Open the host or member badges to check who runs and attends the event.
messages.guide.events.followed.card-badge-start.d: Open the organizer profile to check who hosts an event you follow. This can provide useful context before you decide to participate.
messages.guide.events.followed.card-badge-end.des: Review event members and participation counts from the card. Pending markers show where requests or attendance changes need attention.
messages.guide.events.followed.checkout-draft.tri: Reopen an unfinished event checkout and continue from its saved selections. Review any changed event details before submitting the payment or request.
messages.guide.event.explore.event-explore-filter: Set preferences such as friends, open places, topic, and event mode to narrow discovery. The filter counter shows when the list is limited by your choices.
Choose which events appear first, such as upcoming or recently updated. Sorting changes the order so you can act on the most relevant event sooner.
messages.guide.event.explore.event-explore-view.t: Group results by the available time or distance view. A suitable grouping makes it easier to plan around dates or compare nearby events.
messages.guide.event.explore.event-list.label: Event discovery cards
messages.guide.event.explore.event-list.descripti: Compare event details, host badges, member counts, and available actions. Open a badge to inspect its destination before you decide to join or share the event.
messages.guide.event.explore.card-badge-start.des: Open the host profile to learn who is responsible for the event. This helps you assess the organizer and the community before taking action.
messages.guide.event.explore.card-badge-end.label: Event member list
messages.guide.event.explore.card-badge-end.descr: Open the members view to see attendance and participation requests. The counts on this badge summarize activity that may affect available places.
messages.guide.event.explore.card-actions.label: Event actions
messages.guide.event.explore.card-actions.descrip: Open the card menu to follow an organizer, share the event, or continue an available action. The menu reflects the event’s current state and your access.
messages.guide.event.explore.checkout-draft.trigg: Return to an unfinished checkout from its saved basket. Check the event and selected options again because details may have changed since you left.
messages.guide.event.chat.chat-list.label: Event conversation
messages.guide.event.chat.chat-list.description: Read messages from the event community and use the conversation to coordinate with participants. The current event context remains attached to the chat.
messages.guide.event.chat.chat-compose.label: Message composer
messages.guide.event.chat.chat-compose.descriptio: Write an update, question, or reply for this event conversation. Check the audience before sending so the right participants receive the information.
messages.guide.event.chat.chat-send.label: Send event message
messages.guide.event.chat.chat-send.description: Send your message to the event chat. Once sent, it becomes part of the conversation that eligible participants can read.
messages.guide.event.chat.chat-attachments.label: Add to a message
messages.guide.event.chat.chat-attachments.descri: Open the plus menu to attach a photo, voice clip, poll, event, or asset. This lets you share context in the conversation instead of sending text alone.
messages.guide.event.chat.chat-message-actions.de: Use an individual message menu to reply, react, or review related details. These actions keep responses connected to the message they refer to.
messages.guide.event.chat.chat-members.label: Event chat members
messages.guide.event.chat.chat-members.descriptio: Open participant details to see who can take part in this conversation. Membership context helps you understand who will receive shared updates.
messages.guide.event.members.members-list.label: Member cards
messages.guide.event.members.members-list.descrip: Review member profiles, roles, and participation status. The list helps organizers understand who is attending and which requests still need a response.
messages.guide.event.members.pending-only.label: Show pending requests
messages.guide.event.members.pending-only.descrip: Turn this filter on to focus on people whose requests are not resolved yet. Turn it off to return to the full member list.
messages.guide.event.members.invite.label: Invite participants
messages.guide.event.members.invite.description: Open the invitation flow to add eligible people to the event. Confirm the event and recipients before sending, since this creates new invitations.
messages.guide.event.members.member-actions.label: Member actions
messages.guide.event.members.member-actions.descr: Open a member’s action menu to review role-specific options. The available actions depend on your permissions and the person’s participation state.
messages.guide.event.members.members-close.label: Close member list
messages.guide.event.members.members-close.descri: Return to the event or activity that opened this member list. Closing the guide keeps the list open so you can continue reviewing people.
messages.guide.event.checkout.checkout-event.desc: Review which event and options are included before continuing. This summary helps catch changes before a payment or participation request is submitted.
messages.guide.event.checkout.checkout-slot.label: Choose an event time
messages.guide.event.checkout.checkout-slot.descr: Select an available time slot or session when the event offers choices. Your selection determines which schedule and places are reserved in the next step.
messages.guide.event.checkout.checkout-options.de: Select optional stages or activities you want to attend. The total and participation details update to reflect the items you include.
messages.guide.event.checkout.checkout-payment.de: Choose or review the method used for this checkout. Confirm the amount and provider before you authorize a payment.
messages.guide.event.checkout.checkout-promo.desc: Apply an eligible promo code and check how it changes the price summary. The code is applied to this checkout only when it is accepted.
messages.guide.event.checkout.checkout-confirm.de: Review the final details and submit the selected request or payment. This action may create a reservation or charge, so check the summary first.
messages.guide.event.resources.resource-filter.tr: Choose which resource type or status to browse for this event. Filtering helps you find transport, supplies, accommodation, or another needed item.
messages.guide.event.resources.resource-list.desc: Compare resource details, availability, and owner information before opening a request. The list keeps the event context so selected resources are attached to the right activity.
messages.guide.event.resources.resource-card-star: Shows the assigned vehicle’s route or the accommodation’s location on a map. Use it to check where you need to travel.
Compares participation with this resource’s capacity. Opening it shows the related members; pending requests are counted separately.
messages.guide.event.resources.resource-card-acti: Open the resource menu to request, review, or manage it when permitted. The menu reflects your role and the resource’s current status.
messages.guide.event.resources.resource-paginatio: Continue through matching event resources without changing the selected event or filter. This reveals more options when the current page is not enough.
messages.guide.event.subevents.subevent-list.desc: Review the stages or groups attached to the event and open one for its resources and participants. This keeps a complex event organized into manageable parts.
messages.guide.event.subevents.subevent-card-star: Check the status badge to see whether a stage is scheduled, active, waiting, or complete. Its state tells you what can happen next.
Open the member list for people assigned to this stage. Use it to review participation separately from the event’s overall member list.
messages.guide.event.subevents.subevent-card-acti: Open the stage menu to view options allowed for your role and the current stage state. This is where you manage or continue with one part of the event.
messages.guide.event.subevents.subevent-filter.tr: Choose which stage or group records appear. Filtering helps you find the relevant part of a large event without altering its structure.
messages.guide.event.subevents.subevent-paginatio: Move to additional stages or groups in the event. Your current event context remains in place as you continue through the list.
messages.guide.event.feedback.detail.feedback-det: Review your submitted answers and the event context they refer to. The detail view helps you understand what was recorded without changing your response.
messages.guide.event.feedback.detail.feedback-ans: Read the main answer saved for this feedback prompt. It helps you confirm the core response before checking any additional details.
Review any secondary answer connected to the prompt. This extra detail adds nuance to the feedback the organizer receives.
messages.guide.event.feedback.detail.feedback-det: Return to the previous feedback or event screen when you finish reviewing. Closing this guide leaves the detail popup open.
messages.guide.context.home.filters.title: Profile filters
messages.guide.context.home.filters.description: Set who can appear in discovery using age, height, identity, interests, values, and lifestyle preferences. Applying the choices refreshes suggestions without changing anyone’s profile.
messages.guide.context.notifications.title: Notifications
messages.guide.context.notifications.summary: Review updates and continue to their related screens.
messages.guide.context.notifications.description: Choose a notification group, manage alerts, and open the conversations or events behind each update.
messages.guide.context.payment.history.title: Payment history
messages.guide.context.payment.history.summary: Review payment records and account totals.
messages.guide.context.payment.history.descriptio: Filter transactions, compare totals, and manage the payment methods used by supported checkout flows.
messages.guide.context.profile.impressions.title: Profile impressions
messages.guide.context.profile.impressions.descri: Switch between the two roles and browse profile photos to understand the context behind each set of impressions.
messages.guide.context.community.groups.title: Community groups
messages.guide.context.community.groups.descripti: Browse group sections, sort communities, and use card actions to review or manage the groups connected to your account.
messages.guide.context.community.groups.explore.s: Find communities that match your interests.
messages.guide.context.community.groups.explore.d: Filter by category, compare group activity, and review membership details before sending a request to join.
messages.guide.context.community.feed.title: Photo feed
messages.guide.context.community.feed.summary: Browse shared photos and event posts.
messages.guide.context.community.feed.description: Choose a feed status, open post context, and use the available actions to review or share community content.
messages.guide.context.events.followed.title: Followed events
messages.guide.context.events.followed.summary: Review events from organizers you follow.
messages.guide.context.events.followed.descriptio: Filter, sort, and group event cards while keeping the list focused on followed organizers and saved checkout drafts.
messages.guide.context.event.explore.title: Event discovery
messages.guide.context.event.explore.summary: Find events and check their context.
messages.guide.context.event.explore.description: Adjust discovery preferences, choose a useful order and view, then open event badges and actions to understand each opportunity.
messages.guide.context.event.chat.title: Event chat
messages.guide.context.event.chat.description: Read the conversation, share updates or a poll, and use message actions to keep replies connected to the right context.
messages.guide.context.event.members.title: Event members
messages.guide.context.event.members.description: Check member roles and status, focus on pending requests, and invite eligible people when your role allows it.
messages.guide.context.event.checkout.title: Event checkout
messages.guide.context.event.checkout.summary: Confirm event options and payment details.
messages.guide.context.event.checkout.description: Review dates, optional stages, pricing, and payment method before submitting a reservation or charge.
messages.guide.context.event.resources.title: Event resources
messages.guide.context.event.resources.summary: Find resources needed for an event.
messages.guide.context.event.resources.descriptio: Filter resources, compare availability, and review owner and card actions before making a request.
messages.guide.context.event.subevents.title: Event stages and groups
messages.guide.context.event.subevents.summary: Browse the parts of a larger event.
messages.guide.context.event.subevents.descriptio: Review each stage’s status, participants, and actions to understand how the full event is organized.
messages.guide.context.event.feedback.detail.summ: Review the answers saved for an event.
messages.guide.context.event.feedback.detail.desc: Check the main and additional answers, then return to the feedback or event screen when you are done.
messages.guide.common.pagination.prev.label: Previous items
messages.guide.common.pagination.prev.description: Show the previous page or calendar period. Your current filters remain active.
messages.guide.common.pagination.next.label: More items
messages.guide.common.pagination.next.description: Show the next page or calendar period. Your current filters remain active.
messages.guide.assets.card-badge-start.label: Asset owner badge
messages.guide.assets.card-badge-start.descriptio: Open the owner profile to see who is responsible for this item. That context can help you decide whether to request or assign it.
messages.guide.assets.card-badge-end.label: Asset availability badge
messages.guide.assets.card-badge-end.description: Review availability, requests, or quantity from this badge. Its count helps you see whether the item fits your current plan.
messages.guide.assets.card-actions.label: Asset actions
messages.guide.assets.card-actions.description: Open the card menu to edit, assign, or manage requests for this item. Only actions available for its type and your role are shown.
messages.guide.event.resources.resource-actions.t: Open the resource tools to assign items or review requests connected to this event. The available choices depend on your access.
messages.guide.payment.history.row-actions.label: Payment record actions
messages.guide.payment.history.row-actions.descri: Open a transaction’s menu to inspect or manage that record. Payment history is separate from the saved methods used for future checkouts.
messages.guide.event.feedback.card-badge-start.de: Open the profile connected to this feedback entry. This helps you understand whose experience is summarized before reviewing the details.
messages.guide.event.feedback.card-badge-end.desc: Check the status and event details shown on the card. These indicators help you see which feedback entries still need attention.
messages.guide.event.feedback.card-actions.label: Feedback actions
messages.guide.event.feedback.card-actions.descri: Open the card menu to review the available feedback actions. The menu reflects whether the item is pending, submitted, or no longer available.
messages.guide.event.subevents.order.trigger.desc: Choose whether upcoming or past stages appear first. This changes the list order while keeping the selected event and its stages together.
messages.guide.event.subevents.view.trigger.label: List or calendar
messages.guide.event.subevents.view.trigger.descr: Choose Day, Week, Month or Distance where available. Calendar views use period arrows; lists use scrolling.
messages.guide.event.subevents.context.trigger.de: Open event tools for stage setup, member and resource access, or status changes. Available actions depend on your role and the event state.
messages.guide.profile.view.about.label: About this person
messages.guide.profile.view.about.description: Read the profile introduction and personal notes to understand what matters to them. These details add context beyond the short card preview.
messages.guide.profile.view.detail-groups.label: Profile details
messages.guide.profile.view.detail-groups.descrip: Information is grouped by topic, and only details shared with you are shown. Use these sections for context without assuming anything that is hidden.
messages.guide.profile.editor.profile-status.trig: Choose who can see this profile. Visibility affects discovery and profile access, while saved profile details remain unchanged.
messages.guide.profile.editor.calendar-export.des: Export your event schedule for use in another calendar. The export copies calendar data; it does not change event participation.
messages.guide.profile.editor.api-integration.des: Affiliate contains your referral link, API keys and AI-client connections through MCP. Admin accounts open their management API settings here.
messages.guide.event.editor.capacity.label: Event capacity
messages.guide.event.editor.capacity.description: Set the minimum and maximum number of participants. Clear limits help guests understand whether places are available before requesting to join.
messages.guide.event.editor.location.label: Event location
messages.guide.event.editor.location.description: Add a place so participants know where the event happens. A precise location also helps people plan travel and check distance.
messages.guide.event.editor.description.label: Event description
messages.guide.event.editor.description.descripti: Explain what participants will do and what they should know beforehand. Helpful details set expectations and make it easier to decide whether to join.
messages.guide.event.editor.date.label: Event dates
messages.guide.event.editor.date.description: Choose when the event starts and ends. The date and time determine how it appears in schedules and help guests avoid conflicts.
messages.guide.event.editor.definitions.label: Stages and groups
messages.guide.event.editor.definitions.descripti: Configure optional stages or tournament groups for this event. A clear structure helps participants understand the schedule and where each activity belongs.
messages.guide.event.editor.slots.label: Participation slots
messages.guide.event.editor.slots.description: Define the time slots people can choose. Separate slots make capacity and attendance easier to manage when the event has several sessions.
messages.guide.event.editor.pricing.label: Event pricing
messages.guide.event.editor.pricing.description: Set the cost and payment terms participants will see. Clear pricing helps people understand the commitment before confirming a place.
messages.guide.event.editor.policies.label: Event policies
messages.guide.event.editor.policies.description: Add rules participants may need to read or accept. Clear policies explain expectations and can appear in the checkout or request flow.
messages.guide.home.filters.basics.label: Age and height
messages.guide.home.filters.basics.description: Set the age and height ranges for people shown in discovery. These limits narrow suggestions to profiles that better fit what you are looking for.
messages.guide.home.filters.apply.label: Apply filters
messages.guide.home.filters.apply.description: Save these choices and return to discovery with updated results. You can reopen the filter popup later to adjust them.
messages.guide.home.filters.close.label: Close filters
messages.guide.home.filters.close.description: Close this popup and return to discovery. Unapplied edits are not saved, so use Apply when you want the new choices to take effect.
messages.guide.home.filters.horoscopes.label: Horoscope
messages.guide.home.filters.horoscopes.descriptio: Choose horoscope signs to include in discovery. This narrows suggestions without changing anyone’s profile.
messages.guide.home.filters.languages.label: Languages
messages.guide.home.filters.languages.description: Select languages that matter for conversation. Matching this preference can help you find people you can communicate with more easily.
messages.guide.home.filters.values.label: Values
messages.guide.home.filters.values.description: Choose values that are important to you. The filter brings profiles with compatible priorities into your discovery list.
messages.guide.home.filters.religions.label: Beliefs
messages.guide.home.filters.religions.description: Select belief preferences that matter in a connection. These choices refine suggestions and follow your profile privacy settings.
messages.guide.home.filters.interests.label: Interests
messages.guide.home.filters.interests.description: Choose shared interests to look for. Similar interests can give you an easy starting point for a conversation or activity.
messages.guide.home.filters.physiques.label: Physique
messages.guide.home.filters.physiques.description: Set the body-type preferences discovery should consider. This narrows cards without changing anyone’s profile data.
messages.guide.home.filters.smoking.label: Smoking
messages.guide.home.filters.smoking.description: Choose the smoking preferences you want to see. This helps focus on profiles whose lifestyle details fit your expectations.
messages.guide.home.filters.drinking.label: Drinking
messages.guide.home.filters.drinking.description: Set which drinking habits are relevant to you. This makes lifestyle expectations easier to compare before opening a profile.
messages.guide.home.filters.workout.label: Exercise
messages.guide.home.filters.workout.description: Choose activity levels that suit your lifestyle. Matching this preference can help you find people with similar routines.
messages.guide.home.filters.pets.label: Pets
messages.guide.home.filters.pets.description: Select pet preferences that matter in your home and plans. This can prevent mismatched expectations before you arrange to meet.
messages.guide.home.filters.genders.label: Gender
messages.guide.home.filters.genders.description: Choose which genders to include in discovery. Your selection controls the profiles shown and can be changed later.
messages.guide.home.filters.traitLabels.label: Personality traits
messages.guide.home.filters.traitLabels.descripti: Select traits you value in a connection. This can make profiles with compatible qualities easier to find and compare.
messages.guide.home.filters.familyPlans.label: Family plans
messages.guide.home.filters.familyPlans.descripti: Choose family plans that align with yours. Comparing this early helps decide which profiles to explore in more detail.
messages.guide.home.filters.children.label: Children
messages.guide.home.filters.children.description: Set whether having children is an important preference. This aligns discovery with your current family situation and plans.
messages.guide.home.filters.loveStyles.label: Relationship style
messages.guide.home.filters.loveStyles.descriptio: Choose relationship styles you are open to. Clear preferences make it easier to find people with similar expectations.
messages.guide.home.filters.communicationStyles.d: Select ways of communicating that feel comfortable. This adds context to discovery and can guide a natural first conversation.
messages.guide.home.filters.sexualOrientations.de: Choose orientation preferences relevant to discovery. These choices affect the profiles shown, not their stored information.
messages.guide.profile.impressions.close.label: Close impressions
messages.guide.profile.impressions.close.descript: Close this view to return to the profile or screen that opened it. The impression history remains available from the same entry point.
messages.guide.event.feedback.detail.close.label: Close feedback details
messages.guide.event.feedback.detail.close.descri: Close the saved feedback summary to return to the feedback list or event. The recorded answers remain saved after you leave this view.
messages.guide.assets.asset-form.label: Asset form
messages.guide.assets.asset-form.description: This form defines the item other people can request. Add accurate details so members can compare it and understand what they will receive.
messages.guide.assets.asset-flow.label: Asset details
messages.guide.assets.asset-flow.description: The form groups the item’s identity, availability and terms into sections. Complete the relevant parts so requests use the right details and limits.
messages.guide.assets.imageUrls.label: Asset photo
messages.guide.assets.imageUrls.description: Add a clear photo so people can recognize the item before requesting it. A representative image reduces confusion when several assets are available.
messages.guide.assets.title.label: Asset name
messages.guide.assets.title.description: Choose a short name that identifies the item in lists and requests. A specific title helps members distinguish it from similar equipment.
messages.guide.assets.subtitle.label: Short description
messages.guide.assets.subtitle.description: Use this line for the detail people need at a glance, such as size or intended use. It appears beside the title in compact asset cards.
messages.guide.assets.capacityTotal.label: Total capacity
messages.guide.assets.capacityTotal.description: Set how many units can be requested at once. This limit helps prevent more people from reserving the asset than you can provide.
messages.guide.assets.quantity.label: Requested quantity
messages.guide.assets.quantity.description: Enter the number of units needed for this assignment. The available range follows the event’s capacity so the request stays within its limits.
messages.guide.assets.sourceLink.label: Reference link
messages.guide.assets.sourceLink.description: Add a product or reference page when people need more specifications. The link gives them context without crowding the asset description.
messages.guide.assets.category.label: Asset category
messages.guide.assets.category.description: Choose the category that best describes this item. Categorization places it in the right asset list and makes it easier to find.
messages.guide.assets.details.label: Full description
messages.guide.assets.details.description: Explain the item’s condition, contents and any practical limits. Clear details help someone decide whether it fits their needs before sending a request.
messages.guide.assets.routeLocation.label: Location
messages.guide.assets.routeLocation.description: Set where the asset is located so borrowers know where pickup or use will happen. A precise place makes coordination easier during the event.
messages.guide.assets.runtimeRoutes.label: Event route
messages.guide.assets.runtimeRoutes.description: Set the route used for this event assignment. This is useful when a transport asset follows a route that differs from its usual listing.
messages.guide.assets.pricing.label: Pricing
messages.guide.assets.pricing.description: Review the price and any time-based charges before publishing the asset. These values are used to show the cost during a request or checkout.
messages.guide.assets.policies.label: Lending terms
messages.guide.assets.policies.description: Add terms borrowers must read or approve before completing a request. Clear rules protect both sides and explain how the item should be used or returned.
messages.guide.assets.asset-editor-visibility.tri: Choose who can discover or request this asset. The setting controls whether it appears broadly or only to a narrower event audience.
messages.guide.assets.asset-editor-save.label: Save asset
messages.guide.assets.asset-editor-save.descripti: Save the details and make the asset available according to its visibility. Check the required fields first so the listing can be used immediately.
messages.guide.assets.asset-editor-runtime-route-: Save the route for this event assignment. The updated path is then used to coordinate transport with the event participants.
Choose whether the group is public, private or invitation-only. This controls who can find it and how people request access.
messages.guide.community.group.editor.save.label: Save group
messages.guide.community.group.editor.save.descri: Save the group after checking its name and visibility. Members will see the updated information the next time they open it.
messages.guide.community.group.editor.image.label: Group image
messages.guide.community.group.editor.image.descr: Add an image that helps people recognize the group in lists and invitations. A clear visual makes the group easier to distinguish.
messages.guide.community.group.editor.name.label: Group name
messages.guide.community.group.editor.name.descri: Choose a concise name that tells people what connects the group. It appears in search results, invitations and group cards.
messages.guide.community.group.editor.description: Explain the group’s purpose and who it is for. This helps people decide whether to join before they share information or request access.
messages.guide.community.group.editor.category.de: Pick a category that matches the group’s purpose. Categories make browsing more useful and help members find relevant communities.
messages.guide.community.group.editor.members-vis: Choose whether people can see the member list. Hiding it gives members more privacy before they join or participate.
messages.guide.community.group.editor.rules-enabl: Turn on profile rules when some details are needed for trust or coordination. People will be asked for the selected information before joining.
Open the selector to decide which profile details members must provide. Keep the list focused so the request remains relevant and comfortable.
messages.guide.community.group.editor.rules-table: Review the selected profile details here. This summary helps you confirm what members will be asked to share before they join.
messages.guide.community.group.editor.group-polic: Add rules people must understand or approve before joining. These terms set shared expectations and explain how the group operates.
messages.guide.community.group.editor.close.label: Close group editor
messages.guide.community.group.editor.close.descr: Close this editor to return to the group list. Unsaved changes are not applied until you use Save.
messages.guide.community.group.policy.policy-fiel: Select the details that help members coordinate or establish trust. The enabled choices become the information requested from new members.
messages.guide.community.group.policy.done.label: Apply privacy rules
messages.guide.community.group.policy.done.descri: Apply your choices and return to the group editor. You can review the selected requirements before saving the group.
messages.guide.community.group.policy.close.label: Close privacy rules
messages.guide.community.group.policy.close.descr: Close the selector and return to the group editor. Changes are applied only when you confirm them with the check button.
messages.guide.event.tournament.groups.tournament: Choose a stage
Switch between event stages to review the groups and results for each one. The selected stage determines which standings appear below.
Group actions
Open the organizer actions for the selected stage. Available actions depend on your role and may include creating a group.
Create another group for this stage when participants need separate standings. New groups appear in the list and can receive their own results.
messages.guide.event.tournament.groups.tournament: Group list
Browse the groups configured for the selected stage. Open a group to inspect its participants, standings and history.
Inspect the first group
Expand a group to inspect its standings or table seats. Its member count and capacity describe that group, not the entire event.
messages.guide.event.tournament.groups.mingle-tab: See who has been assigned to this table and which seats are still empty. The layout helps organizers check that each round has a usable group.
messages.guide.event.tournament.groups.tournament: Group result tabs
Switch between current standings and past results for this group. The selected tab changes which information is shown below.
Standings
Show each participant’s current score or tournament position. Select a row to open that person’s recorded results.
Result history
Review score updates or completed matches recorded for this group. This makes earlier changes easier to verify.
Participant standing
Select a participant to inspect their result history. Tournament rows summarize score, position and recent updates in one place.
Recorded results
The history lists results already saved for the selected participant or group. Use it to check what has been recorded before adding another update.
Result entry
Each row contains a saved score or match with its date and any note. Reviewing these details helps explain how the current standings were calculated.
Save result
Save the score or match result for this group. It updates the history and recalculates the participant standings.
messages.guide.event.tournament.groups.close.desc: Close this view to return to the event. Your saved groups and results remain attached to the selected event stage.
messages.guide.event.mingle.configuration.mingle-: Choose how many people meet at each table in a round. Smaller tables create more direct conversations; larger ones fit bigger events.
Set how many conversation rounds the event should run. More rounds let participants meet more people but make the activity longer.
Choose how many minutes participants have at each table. Leave enough time for a useful conversation while keeping the event on schedule.
Set a short pause for moving to the next table. A break helps participants change seats without cutting into conversation time.
Ask the assignment logic to balance groups using the event’s available gender information. This can shape table composition when participants have shared those details.
messages.guide.event.mingle.configuration.save.de: Apply these settings to the event’s mingle rounds. The organizer can then start tables using the chosen group size and timing.
messages.guide.event.mingle.configuration.close.d: Close this panel and return to the event editor. Use Save if you want the changed round settings to take effect.
messages.guide.assets.checkout.asset-checkout-bas: Review the selected item, quantity and dates before continuing. The summary helps catch a mismatch before you submit a request or payment.
messages.guide.assets.checkout.asset-checkout-pay: Choose or confirm the payment method and review its status. The payment step completes the request only after the required details are accepted.
Borrowing uses the chosen period to calculate availability and price. Joining an event assignment uses that activity’s fixed start and end.
messages.guide.assets.checkout.asset-checkout-ref: Review the refund terms that apply to this request. They explain what may be returned if plans change after payment.
messages.guide.assets.checkout.asset-checkout-act: The button states the next action: send a request, continue to payment or finalize. A pending request is not yet an approved place.
messages.guide.assets.checkout.close.label: Close asset checkout
messages.guide.assets.checkout.close.description: Close the checkout flow and return to the asset screen. If you have not confirmed the request, it will not be submitted by closing.
messages.guide.profile.integrations.integration-s: This screen contains the account details used by connected apps. Share only the information needed by a trusted client.
messages.guide.profile.integrations.integration-b: Your client sends API requests to this address. Use this installation’s exact URL; the client key determines which account it acts for.
messages.guide.profile.integrations.integration-t: Each key connects a client to the issuing profile or group. Keep separate keys so one client’s access can be revoked independently.
messages.guide.profile.integrations.generate-inte: A new key allows a supported client to connect. Its secret appears once: copy it into that client’s settings, never into a public message.
messages.guide.profile.integrations.integration-t: Connected means this key has been claimed by a client. Expiry ends its validity; the prefix identifies the key without revealing its secret.
Revoking invalidates this key. That client loses API access with it; the other keys remain independently managed.
messages.guide.profile.integrations.integration-h: Open the help panel for connection guidance. It explains what information a client needs and where to configure it.
messages.guide.profile.integrations.close.label: Close integrations
messages.guide.profile.integrations.close.descrip: Close these settings and return to the previous screen. Existing client keys keep their current access until you revoke them.
messages.guide.context.community.group.editor.sum: Set up a group people can understand, join and use safely.
messages.guide.context.community.group.editor.des: Add a clear name, useful details and an image, then choose who may see and join the group. Member visibility and profile rules help set expectations before people participate.
messages.guide.context.community.group.policy.sum: Decide which profile details members must share with the group.
messages.guide.context.community.group.policy.des: Select only the details that help members coordinate or build trust. Required fields are shown before someone joins, so keep the request relevant to the group.
messages.guide.context.event.tournament.groups.su: Follow each group, standings and score history for the selected stage.
messages.guide.context.event.tournament.groups.de: Open a group to see its standings or match history, then choose another stage from the menu. Hosts can add groups and update results; selecting a participant shows that person’s result history.
messages.guide.context.event.mingle.configuration: Choose table size, timing and balancing rules before the rounds begin.
These settings shape how participants rotate and how long each conversation lasts. Choose a pace that fits the event, then save it so the organizer can start the rounds with a predictable schedule.
messages.guide.context.assets.checkout.title: Request an event asset
messages.guide.context.assets.checkout.summary: Review the item, dates and payment details before confirming.
messages.guide.context.assets.checkout.descriptio: Check what is included, choose the required time range and review any lending terms or refund conditions. The action at the bottom submits the request or payment, so confirm the summary first.
messages.guide.context.profile.integrations.title: Connect apps and manage access
messages.guide.context.profile.integrations.summa: Use integration links and keys to connect trusted tools.
messages.guide.context.profile.integrations.descr: The base URL and client keys let supported apps exchange data with your account. Create a key only for a tool you trust, keep its secret private, and revoke it when it is no longer needed.
messages.guide.context.payment.cash.receipt.title: Record payment received
messages.guide.context.payment.cash.receipt.summa: Record cash or a bank transfer received from a member.
messages.guide.context.payment.cash.receipt.descr: Select the group member, cash or bank transfer, amount, currency and an optional note. Saving records the payment in both members’ histories and notifies the payer. It does not move money.
messages.guide.payment.cash.receipt.payer.label: Payer
messages.guide.payment.cash.receipt.payer.descrip: Choose the member whose payment you received.
messages.guide.payment.cash.receipt.amount.label: Amount received
messages.guide.payment.cash.receipt.amount.descri: Enter the amount you actually received. This value is added to the payment history totals in the selected currency.
messages.guide.payment.cash.receipt.currency.desc: Use the currency that was handed over. The saved history entry and any later refund calculation use this amount and currency together.
messages.guide.payment.cash.receipt.note.label: Note
messages.guide.payment.cash.receipt.note.descript: Add a short reference such as what the payment covers. The note stays with this history entry so it is easier to recognize later.
messages.guide.payment.cash.receipt.save.label: Save receipt
messages.guide.payment.cash.receipt.save.descript: Check the member, method, amount and currency, then save. The payment appears in both histories and the payer receives a notification.
messages.guide.payment.cash.receipt.close.label: Close receipt form
messages.guide.payment.cash.receipt.close.descrip: Close this form without saving the receipt. You return to payment history, where you can open the form again if needed.
messages.guide.profile.editor.about.label: About you
messages.guide.profile.editor.about.description: Write a short introduction. This text helps people understand who you are before meeting you.
messages.guide.profile.editor.birthday.label: Birthday
messages.guide.profile.editor.birthday.descriptio: Your birth date determines your age and horoscope. Check it before saving your profile.
messages.guide.profile.editor.city.label: Home city
messages.guide.profile.editor.city.description: Choose your city so discovery and events can use the right location.
messages.guide.profile.editor.height.label: Height
messages.guide.profile.editor.height.description: Enter your height in centimetres. It can be used in profile filters.
messages.guide.profile.editor.physique.label: Physique
messages.guide.profile.editor.physique.descriptio: Choose the description that fits you. This value is part of your profile and discovery preferences.
messages.guide.profile.editor.gender.label: Gender
messages.guide.profile.editor.gender.description: Choose the gender shown on your profile and used in discovery.
messages.guide.profile.editor.profession.label: Profession
messages.guide.profile.editor.profession.descript: Describe your work. Use the visibility control beside the field to choose who can see it.
messages.guide.profile.editor.workspace.label: Workplaces
messages.guide.profile.editor.workspace.descripti: Open your workplace history to add or review experience. Changes are saved with your profile.
messages.guide.profile.editor.school.label: Education
messages.guide.profile.editor.school.description: Open your education history to add or review schools. The visibility control sets who can see this information.
messages.guide.profile.editor.drinking.label: Drinking habits
messages.guide.profile.editor.drinking.descriptio: Select the option that describes your drinking habits. Use the adjacent control to set its visibility.
messages.guide.profile.editor.smoking.label: Smoking habits
messages.guide.profile.editor.smoking.description: Select your smoking habits and choose who can see them with the adjacent visibility control.
messages.guide.profile.editor.workout.label: Exercise
messages.guide.profile.editor.workout.description: Choose how often you exercise. The adjacent visibility control determines who can see your answer.
messages.guide.profile.editor.pets.label: Pets
messages.guide.profile.editor.pets.description: Choose the pets that are part of your life. You can set this field’s visibility separately.
messages.guide.profile.editor.familyPlans.label: Family plans
messages.guide.profile.editor.familyPlans.descrip: Choose the option that reflects your plans. Decide who can see it with the visibility control.
messages.guide.profile.editor.children.label: Children
messages.guide.profile.editor.children.descriptio: Choose the answer that fits your situation. The visibility control lets you keep this detail private.
messages.guide.profile.editor.loveStyle.label: Love style
messages.guide.profile.editor.loveStyle.descripti: Choose how you prefer a connection to develop. Its visibility is controlled separately.
Select the way you prefer to communicate. Set who can see it with the adjacent visibility control.
messages.guide.profile.editor.sexualOrientation.d: Choose the answer you want to include in your profile. You control who can see this detail.
messages.guide.profile.editor.religion.label: Religion
messages.guide.profile.editor.religion.descriptio: Choose the option that describes your beliefs, and set its visibility separately.
