messages.guide.profile.editor.values.label: Values
messages.guide.profile.editor.values.description: Select the values that matter to you. Use the visibility control to choose who can see them.
messages.guide.events.secondary.trigger.label: Time period
messages.guide.events.secondary.trigger.descripti: Choose upcoming or past activity. This changes which events appear without modifying any event.
messages.guide.events.view.trigger.label: List or calendar
messages.guide.events.view.trigger.description: Choose Day, Week, Month or Distance where available. Calendar views use period arrows; lists use scrolling.
messages.guide.events.event-explore.label: Explore events
messages.guide.events.event-explore.description: Open event discovery to find activities outside your current list. Discovery has its own filters and guide.
messages.guide.events.quick-actions.trigger.label: Event actions
messages.guide.events.quick-actions.trigger.descr: Open the available creation and management shortcuts. The guide explains them without performing an action.
Choose upcoming or past activity. This changes which events appear without modifying any event.
messages.guide.event.subevents.event-explore.desc: Open event discovery to find activities outside your current list. Discovery has its own filters and guide.
messages.guide.event.subevents.quick-actions.trig: Open the available creation and management shortcuts. The guide explains them without performing an action.
messages.guide.card.action.manageEvent.label: Manage event
messages.guide.card.action.manageEvent.descriptio: Open the event workspace to manage its details, stages and participants.
messages.guide.card.action.view.label: View event
messages.guide.card.action.view.description: Open the event details and available stages. This does not join the event.
messages.guide.card.action.editEvent.label: Edit event
messages.guide.card.action.editEvent.description: Open the editor to change event details. Changes take effect only when you save.
messages.guide.card.action.notifyParticipants.des: Open a message to the event’s participants. Review the audience and text before sending.
messages.guide.card.action.shareEvent.label: Share event
messages.guide.card.action.shareEvent.description: Open the sharing options for this event so you can send its link to others.
messages.guide.card.action.externalInfo.label: External information
messages.guide.card.action.externalInfo.descripti: Open the external information link supplied for this event. It may lead to another website.
messages.guide.card.action.publish.label: Publish
messages.guide.card.action.publish.description: Make this item available to its configured audience. Check its details and visibility first.
messages.guide.card.action.unpublish.label: Unpublish
messages.guide.card.action.unpublish.description: Withdraw this item from its published audience. Review the confirmation before continuing.
messages.guide.card.action.cancelEvent.label: Cancel event
messages.guide.card.action.cancelEvent.descriptio: Start cancelling this event. Review the effect on participants and payments before confirming.
messages.guide.card.action.deleteEvent.label: Delete event
messages.guide.card.action.deleteEvent.descriptio: Start deleting this event. Read the confirmation carefully before removing it.
messages.guide.card.action.followOrganizer.label: Follow organizer
messages.guide.card.action.followOrganizer.descri: Follow this organizer to find their eligible events in Followed. It does not join an event.
messages.guide.card.action.unfollowOrganizer.desc: Stop following this organizer. Your existing event participation is separate from following.
messages.guide.card.action.requestJoin.label: Request to join
messages.guide.card.action.requestJoin.descriptio: Start a request to participate. Review any requirements, options and price before confirming.
messages.guide.card.action.bookEvent.label: Book event
messages.guide.card.action.bookEvent.description: Open booking to review attendance options and payment. Nothing is confirmed by opening it.
messages.guide.card.action.joinWaitlist.label: Join waiting list
messages.guide.card.action.joinWaitlist.descripti: Request a place on the waiting list. This is not a confirmed place at the event.
messages.guide.card.action.leaveEvent.label: Leave event
messages.guide.card.action.leaveEvent.description: Start leaving this event. Review the participation and refund details before confirming.
messages.guide.card.action.addWatchlist.label: Add to watchlist
messages.guide.card.action.addWatchlist.descripti: Keep this event in your watchlist so you can return to it later. This does not join the event.
messages.guide.card.action.removeWatchlist.label: Remove from watchlist
messages.guide.card.action.removeWatchlist.descri: Remove this event from your watchlist. Your event participation stays separate.
messages.guide.card.action.askOrganizer.label: Ask organizer
messages.guide.card.action.askOrganizer.descripti: Open a conversation with the organizer about this event. You can review the message before sending.
messages.guide.card.action.reportOrganizer.label: Report organizer
messages.guide.card.action.reportOrganizer.descri: Open the reporting form for the organizer. Explain the issue before submitting it for review.
messages.guide.card.action.editAsset.label: Edit asset
messages.guide.card.action.editAsset.description: Open the editor for this asset’s details, capacity, pricing and policies. Save to apply changes.
messages.guide.card.action.viewAsset.label: View asset
messages.guide.card.action.viewAsset.description: Open the asset details to review its availability and requirements.
messages.guide.card.action.borrowAsset.label: Borrow asset
messages.guide.card.action.borrowAsset.descriptio: Open the request form to review dates, quantity and any payment before confirming.
messages.guide.card.action.assetAvailability.desc: Review this asset’s availability and reservations for the selected period.
messages.guide.card.action.capacity.label: Capacity
messages.guide.card.action.capacity.description: Review the asset’s capacity and current assignments before changing allocation.
messages.guide.card.action.route.label: Route
messages.guide.card.action.route.description: Open the transport route and its stops to review pickup and destination details.
messages.guide.card.action.contactOwner.label: Contact owner
messages.guide.card.action.contactOwner.descripti: Open a conversation with the owner about this item. No message is sent automatically.
messages.guide.card.action.shareAsset.label: Share asset
messages.guide.card.action.shareAsset.description: Open sharing options for this asset so others can view its details.
messages.guide.card.action.reportOwner.label: Report owner
messages.guide.card.action.reportOwner.descriptio: Open a report about the owner. Describe the issue before submitting it.
messages.guide.card.action.delete.label: Delete item
messages.guide.card.action.delete.description: Start removing this item. Read the confirmation before completing a destructive action.
messages.guide.card.action.startFeedback.label: Give feedback
messages.guide.card.action.startFeedback.descript: Open the feedback form for this event. Your answers are recorded only when submitted.
Open the feedback you already submitted for this event.
messages.guide.event.editor.event-capacity-min.de: This is the event’s minimum attendance setting. Once published, the minimum is locked; the maximum can still be adjusted within the allowed limits.
messages.guide.event.editor.event-capacity-max.de: This is the event’s participant limit. Raising it makes room for more participants; existing participation can restrict how far you lower it.
messages.guide.event.editor.event-blind-mode.desc: Blind Event hides attendees from each other before the event. Turn it off when guests should be able to preview who is coming.
messages.guide.event.editor.event-topics.label: Who the event interests
messages.guide.event.editor.event-topics.descript: Choose up to five topics. People can find the event through topic filters; accurate topics help it reach the right audience.
messages.guide.event.editor.event-auto-inviter.de: When enabled, invitations use mutual preferences to find suitable people. When off, you control invitations manually.
messages.guide.event.editor.event-ticketing.label: QR entry tickets
messages.guide.event.editor.event-ticketing.descr: Accepted attendees receive a QR ticket. An event manager can check it in once; this switch controls entry tickets, not the event price.
messages.guide.event.editor.event-approval-requir: Auto approve off: join requests wait for an event admin. On: confirmed bookings can proceed without that manual approval.
messages.guide.event.editor.event-source-link.des: This link gives guests an external information page. Use it for details that belong outside the event description.
Enable sub-events when the programme needs separate activities or stages. Each definition adds its own timing and participation rules.
messages.guide.event.editor.event-mode.trigger.de: The mode determines how stages work: a programme, a scored competition, or rotating conversations. Choose it before defining the stages.
messages.guide.event.editor.event-mode.Casual.des: Use Standard for activities without tournament progression or rotating tables. Sub-events can be mandatory or optional parts of the programme.
messages.guide.event.editor.event-mode.Tournament: Tournament stages organize groups, scores and progression. Their configuration determines how participants move through the competition.
messages.guide.event.editor.event-mode.Mingle.des: Mingle assigns people to tables across timed rounds. Group size, round length and breaks determine how many conversations fit the event.
messages.guide.event.editor.event-mode-locked.des: This view shows the existing event mode. It cannot be changed here; the available stages follow that mode.
messages.guide.event.editor.event-stage-view.trig: Timeline makes the running order easy to compare. Cards show individual stage details. Switching views does not change the programme.
messages.guide.event.editor.event-stage-add.label: Configure the programme
messages.guide.event.editor.event-stage-add.descr: For Standard and Tournament, this opens a new stage draft. For Mingle, it opens table size and round timing settings.
messages.guide.event.editor.event-editor-visibili: Visibility limits the audience: public, friends or invitees. It is separate from approval, which controls whether a join request is accepted.
messages.guide.event.editor.event-editor-publicat: Publication makes the event available to its configured audience. Saving edits and publishing are separate actions.
messages.guide.event.editor.event-editor-save.des: Saving applies this draft to the event. Review capacity, timing and participation settings first; these affect the guests’ options.
messages.guide.profile.integrations.affiliate-lin: People who register through your link are attributed to you. The badge counts those registrations; it does not grant access to their accounts.
messages.guide.profile.integrations.mcp-purpose.l: What an AI client can do
messages.guide.profile.integrations.mcp-purpose.d: Public MCP help is anonymous. Your approved connection can use permitted organizing actions; Read adds queries and Full adds requested background Events. Personal decisions stay in MyScoutee. Role profiles expose statistics only.
messages.guide.profile.integrations.mcp-url.label: Connect through the URL
messages.guide.profile.integrations.mcp-url.descr: Paste this MCP URL into your AI client and choose Connect. Sign in and check the displayed profile and group before approving access.
messages.guide.profile.integrations.mcp-permissio: These are URL-based connections you approved. Each acts within the displayed account’s permissions; access does not bypass ownership rules.
messages.guide.profile.integrations.mcp-connectio: Check the client name, last use and expiry to recognize active access. An expired permission must be renewed before the client can use it again.
Details identify the client and callback. Revoke ends its access, refresh tokens and event subscriptions. Browser logout alone does not revoke this separate authorization.
Use Advanced only for a client that needs an ID and secret. Normal URL-based Connect does not need a manually generated key.
messages.guide.profile.integrations.mcp-manual-ke: These keys belong to manually configured MCP clients. URL-based OAuth permissions are managed separately on the previous screen.
Generation creates a client ID and a one-time secret. Copy both into the intended client’s settings; do not paste the secret into chat.
messages.guide.event.subevents.card-actions.group: Groups show this stage’s participants and results. In Mingle, they show table assignments for the round.
messages.guide.event.subevents.card-actions.membe: Review participation in this activity. Optional sub-events can have their own membership instead of including every event participant.
messages.guide.event.subevents.card-actions.trans: Transport assignments belong to this activity. Review vehicles, routes and capacity in its resource list.
messages.guide.event.subevents.card-actions.accom: Accommodation assignments belong to this activity. Their availability and terms come from the assigned resources.
messages.guide.event.subevents.card-actions.suppl: Supply assignments track what this activity needs. Check quantities and availability before requesting or changing an assignment.
messages.guide.profile.integrations.affiliate-rev: Revenue summarizes paid purchases attributed to your referrals, including refunds. These amounts are not your earned commission.
messages.guide.profile.integrations.revenue-purch: Counts paid purchases attributed to people you invited. It is a purchase count, so it need not equal the number of invited users.
messages.guide.profile.integrations.revenue-booki: Counts attributed paid event bookings. This separates event booking activity from the overall purchase count.
messages.guide.profile.integrations.revenue-gross: The total attributed purchase amount before refunds. The selected display currency converts the summary; it does not change any payment.
messages.guide.profile.integrations.revenue-refun: Refunds reduce the attributed purchase total. Compare them with the original total to understand the amount remaining after refunds.
messages.guide.profile.integrations.revenue-net.d: This is attributed purchase revenue minus refunds. It is not a payout balance or earned affiliate commission.
messages.guide.profile.integrations.revenue-commi: The affiliate commission rate and eligibility rules are not set. This summary measures referral revenue, not money currently owed to you.

messages.guide.event.subevents.context.participan: Shows the activities you participate in within this event. Turning it off restores the wider programme; it does not change your membership.
messages.guide.event.subevents.context.edit.label: Change event details
messages.guide.event.subevents.context.edit.descr: The editor changes the parent event’s settings. Published events restrict some fields to protect existing participation.
messages.guide.event.subevents.context.manage.des: The editor changes the parent event’s settings. Published events restrict some fields to protect existing participation.
messages.guide.event.subevents.context.view.label: Review event settings
messages.guide.event.subevents.context.view.descr: Shows the event’s details without editing them. Participation and booking are handled separately.
messages.guide.event.subevents.context.members.de: Opens participants for the parent event. The badge counts pending requests; this list is separate from an optional sub-event’s members.
messages.guide.event.members.card-actions.label: Actions for this person
messages.guide.event.members.card-actions.descrip: The menu applies to this person’s membership. Role and participation state determine which actions are available.
messages.guide.event.members.card-actions.member-: Where this person participates
Shows the person’s participation across activities. Use it to understand their assignments before changing membership.
Organizer or participant
Organizer only separates management from attendance. Count as participant includes this organizer in event participation.
Grant management rights
Promotion gives this member administrative or manager permissions for the current event or asset. It changes their role, not your own.
Remove management rights
Revocation removes this member’s manager role. Review the confirmation to distinguish role changes from removing participation.
Give up your manager role
Stepping down removes your management role in this context. It does not promote someone else in your place.
Accept a pending request
Approval accepts this pending participation request. Review the member and event before confirming; this changes their admission state.
Remove this membership
The effect depends on the current state: an invitation, request or existing membership may be removed. Read the confirmation before continuing.
End your participation
Leaving ends your participation in this event. The confirmation explains any relevant booking or payment consequences.
Exclude from the competition
Disqualification changes this participant’s tournament status. Check the person and stage before confirming the exclusion.
Undo disqualification
Reinstatement reverses this participant’s disqualified status where the current stage allows it. Review the confirmation before applying it.
Report a concern
A report sends the described concern for review. It does not directly change the reported person’s role or participation.
messages.guide.event.members.card-status.label: Why participation is pending
messages.guide.event.members.card-status.descript: Invitation pending: the guest must respond. Waiting for approval: an admin must decide. Waiting for payment: payment is unfinished. The icon also distinguishes member roles.
messages.guide.event.members.card-state-detail.de: This label flags payment still due or a removed membership. The menu shows which actions are available in the current state.
messages.guide.events.card-pending-count.label: Requests needing attention
messages.guide.events.card-pending-count.descript: This badge counts pending requests attached to the card. It is separate from accepted participation or occupied capacity; a pending request is not a confirmed place.
messages.guide.events.card-status.label: What this status means
messages.guide.events.card-status.description: The label distinguishes waiting, blocked or inactive items from confirmed ones. Waiting for approval requires a decision before participation is accepted.
messages.guide.event.explore.card-pending-count.d: This badge counts pending requests attached to the card. It is separate from accepted participation or occupied capacity; a pending request is not a confirmed place.
messages.guide.event.explore.card-status.label: What this status means
messages.guide.event.explore.card-status.descript: The label distinguishes waiting, blocked or inactive items from confirmed ones. Waiting for approval requires a decision before participation is accepted.
messages.guide.events.followed.card-pending-count: This badge counts pending requests attached to the card. It is separate from accepted participation or occupied capacity; a pending request is not a confirmed place.

messages.guide.assets.checkout.capacityTotal.desc: Capacity describes what the asset can accommodate. It is not the number of places you personally request or a guarantee that every place is free.

messages.guide.assets.checkout.quantity.descripti: This quantity belongs to the asset or assignment shown here. Locked values are information; joining an assigned vehicle or stay requests one place.

messages.guide.assets.checkout.pricing.descriptio: Borrowing follows quantity and duration rules. For an assigned resource, per-member pricing charges each person; shared pricing divides the total between participants.
messages.guide.assets.checkout.policies.label: Terms of using the asset

messages.guide.assets.checkout.routeLocation.desc: The location identifies the accommodation or pickup point. It belongs to the listed asset; it does not change when you open checkout.

messages.guide.navigation.menu.navigation-profile: The pencil opens the active profile: photos, personal details and preferences. Save in that editor to apply changes.
messages.guide.navigation.menu.navigation-workspa: Switch between your personal profile and available group workspaces. The selected workspace determines whose content and permissions you use.
messages.guide.navigation.menu.notifications.desc: Open notifications directly. Use the existing mute control in the notification popup to hide or restore the floating alert. Notifications and unread counts are kept.
messages.guide.navigation.menu.explanations.label: Show contextual guides
messages.guide.navigation.menu.explanations.descr: Turns the guide button off or back on permanently. The lightbulb offers step-by-step help. Drag the lightbulb or bell to move it; drop on the red X to hide it temporarily.
messages.guide.navigation.menu.settings.label: Account and application tools
messages.guide.navigation.menu.settings.descripti: Opens help, privacy, terms and account actions. Read the relevant confirmation before choosing a destructive action such as deleting the account.
messages.guide.navigation.menu.feed.label: Photos with event context
messages.guide.navigation.menu.feed.description: Browse shared photos or create a post. Each uploaded feed photo needs an event link before the post can be submitted for moderation.
messages.guide.navigation.menu.followed.label: Keep track of organizers
messages.guide.navigation.menu.followed.descripti: Shows events from followed organizers. Following helps you find their events; it does not book a place or join those events.
messages.guide.navigation.menu.groups.label: Community membership
messages.guide.navigation.menu.groups.description: Review your groups, invitations and requests, or explore other communities. Membership and acting in a group workspace are separate choices.
messages.guide.navigation.menu.impressions.label: How others experienced you
messages.guide.navigation.menu.impressions.descri: Shows feedback-based impressions of you as host and attendee. These describe past experiences, rather than editable profile preferences.
messages.guide.navigation.menu.feedback.label: Reflect on attended events
messages.guide.navigation.menu.feedback.descripti: Review pending and completed event feedback. This is feedback about participation; application support is available separately in Settings.
messages.guide.navigation.menu.rates.label: Review profile ratings
messages.guide.navigation.menu.rates.description: Shows your rating activity and its available filters. Rating a profile is separate from accepting an invitation or joining an event.
messages.guide.navigation.menu.chat.label: Conversations by context
messages.guide.navigation.menu.chat.description: Opens conversations for events, groups, contacts and support. Use context filters to find the correct conversation before sending a message.
messages.guide.navigation.menu.invitations.label: Requests for your participation
messages.guide.navigation.menu.invitations.descri: Review invitations and their event details before responding. An invitation alone does not mean your participation or payment is confirmed.
messages.guide.navigation.menu.events.label: Participation and hosting
messages.guide.navigation.menu.events.description: Find events you attend or manage, plus pending and other states. The scope selector separates these roles and lifecycle states.
messages.guide.navigation.menu.payment-history.de: Review payment records and refund states. A pending refund is still in progress; opening this list does not start a payment or refund.
messages.guide.navigation.menu.transport.label: Vehicles and rides
messages.guide.navigation.menu.transport.descript: Manage transport assets and inspect their availability. Owning a vehicle and joining a place on an event’s assigned vehicle are different actions.
messages.guide.navigation.menu.accommodation.desc: Manage accommodation assets, capacity and availability. Booking or joining an assigned stay has its own review and confirmation flow.
messages.guide.navigation.menu.supplies.label: Equipment and contributions
messages.guide.navigation.menu.supplies.descripti: Manage supply assets and quantities. Event assignments and contributions determine how those supplies are used by a particular activity.
messages.guide.navigation.menu.tickets.label: Entry tickets
messages.guide.navigation.menu.tickets.descriptio: View available ticket records and their state. Tickets represent entry rights; payment history records the associated financial transactions.
messages.guide.navigation.menu.contacts.label: People and contact requests
messages.guide.navigation.menu.contacts.descripti: Review contacts and incoming requests. The badge highlights pending requests, so it can differ from the total number of saved contacts.
messages.guide.navigation.menu.close.label: Return to the current screen
messages.guide.navigation.menu.close.description: Closes the avatar menu without opening another section.
messages.guide.context.navigation.menu.title: Avatar menu
messages.guide.context.navigation.menu.summary: Choose a workspace or application section.
messages.guide.context.navigation.menu.descriptio: Understand account tools, community features and activity states.
messages.guide.community.groups.card-actions.view: Opens the group details before you decide to join or change anything. Viewing alone does not create a membership.
messages.guide.community.groups.card-actions.shar: Opens the group invitation link options. The recipient must still follow the group’s joining and approval rules.
messages.guide.community.groups.card-actions.edit: Opens the group draft for an authorized admin. Review visibility, membership rules and policies before saving changes.
messages.guide.community.groups.card-actions.mode: Opens content waiting for group moderation. The count indicates pending reviews; opening the queue does not approve any item.
messages.guide.community.groups.card-actions.remo: Starts the leave flow for your membership. Review its confirmation and any administrator responsibilities before proceeding.
messages.guide.community.groups.card-actions.join: Starts joining this group under its membership rules. If approval is required, a request remains pending until an admin accepts it.
messages.guide.community.groups.card-actions.acce: Accepts an invitation to this group. Read the group’s details and policies before deciding to become a member.
messages.guide.community.groups.card-actions.take: Starts the available group takeover flow. This concerns administration responsibilities; review the confirmation before taking over.
messages.guide.community.groups.card-actions.repo: Opens the reporting flow for this group. Give relevant facts so moderators can assess the issue; it does not leave the group.
messages.guide.community.groups.card-actions.rest: Starts restoration when it is offered for this group or membership. Review the current group state before confirming.
messages.guide.community.groups.explore.card-acti: Read the group profile
Opens the group details before you decide to join or change anything. Viewing alone does not create a membership.
Invite through a link
Opens the group invitation link options. The recipient must still follow the group’s joining and approval rules.
Change group settings
Opens the group draft for an authorized admin. Review visibility, membership rules and policies before saving changes.
Review group content
Opens content waiting for group moderation. The count indicates pending reviews; opening the queue does not approve any item.
Leave the group
Starts the leave flow for your membership. Review its confirmation and any administrator responsibilities before proceeding.
Request group membership
Starts joining this group under its membership rules. If approval is required, a request remains pending until an admin accepts it.
Accept a group invitation
Accepts an invitation to this group. Read the group’s details and policies before deciding to become a member.
Take responsibility for the group
Starts the available group takeover flow. This concerns administration responsibilities; review the confirmation before taking over.
Report a group problem
Opens the reporting flow for this group. Give relevant facts so moderators can assess the issue; it does not leave the group.
Restore an available membership
Starts restoration when it is offered for this group or membership. Review the current group state before confirming.
messages.guide.navigation.menu.settings.permissio: Opens application installation and permission settings. Device permissions control which features can use notifications or location.
messages.guide.navigation.menu.settings.share.des: Opens sharing options for this application. It shares the application link rather than your private profile settings.
messages.guide.navigation.menu.settings.help.desc: Opens the active help document. Its version badge identifies the published help revision available in this installation.
Opens application feedback for questions or suggestions. Use event feedback separately to describe an attended event.
messages.guide.navigation.menu.settings.report-bu: Opens the project’s issue page in another tab. Describe what you did, what happened and what you expected.
messages.guide.navigation.menu.settings.privacy.d: Opens the current privacy document. Its version identifies which published data-handling terms you are reading.
messages.guide.navigation.menu.settings.terms.des: Opens the current application terms. These describe application use; individual events and assets may have additional policies.
messages.guide.navigation.menu.settings.delete-ac: Opens the account deletion flow. Read its consequences before confirming; closing the guide does not delete the account.
messages.guide.navigation.menu.settings.logout.de: Signs you out of the current session. You must sign in again to continue actions that require your account.
messages.guide.event.tournament.groups.tournament: Actions for this group
These actions apply to the selected group in the current stage. Available options depend on your role and the stage’s state.
Record a score or match
When score entry is available, managers can record a score or match result. Results affect standings and advancement; verify the participants and values.
Edit this group
Opens this group’s editable configuration. Changes belong to this group; review its capacity and identity before saving.
Remove a group
Starts removal of this group. Inspect its participants and current stage before confirming a deletion.
Group participation
Opens this group’s member list. Accepted and pending counts differ; pending requests still require the applicable approval.
Transport for this group
Opens transport assigned to this group. Review available places and requests in that resource list.
Accommodation for this group
Opens accommodation assigned to this group. Its capacity and membership are managed separately from the group’s overall size.
Supplies for this group
Opens supplies and contributions for this group. Check quantities there to see what the activity has available.
The badge shows moderation: under review is awaiting a decision, accepted passed review, and rejected or blocked content is restricted. It is not a membership count.
messages.guide.community.groups.explore.card-stat: The badge shows moderation: under review is awaiting a decision, accepted passed review, and rejected or blocked content is restricted. It is not a membership count.
messages.guide.community.feed.card-state-end.desc: The badge shows moderation: under review is awaiting a decision, accepted passed review, and rejected or blocked content is restricted. It is not a membership count.
messages.guide.community.groups.card-state-end.de: This marker identifies a deleted group. Membership counts do not make it active again; use only the restoration action if it is offered.
messages.guide.community.groups.explore.card-stat: This marker identifies a deleted group. Membership counts do not make it active again; use only the restoration action if it is offered.
messages.guide.assets.image-gallery-expand.label: Open all photo slots
messages.guide.assets.image-gallery-expand.descri: The number shows uploaded photos and the maximum slots. Click this badge to open the gallery, inspect the other photos or add and edit images.
Shows uploaded photos and the slot limit. Opens the full gallery; adding or editing photos is available only while the event is editable.
messages.guide.community.group.editor.image-galle: The number shows uploaded photos and the maximum slots. Click this badge to open the gallery, inspect the other photos or add and edit images.
The badge distinguishes scheduled, running, paused and finalized stages, or mandatory/optional activities. It describes that item, not your payment or approval.
messages.guide.event.checkout.image-gallery-expan: The number shows uploaded photos and the maximum slots. Click this badge to open the gallery, inspect the other photos or add and edit images.
This is the event’s minimum attendance setting. Once published, the minimum is locked; the maximum can still be adjusted within the allowed limits.
This is the event’s participant limit. Raising it makes room for more participants; existing participation can restrict how far you lower it.
messages.guide.event.checkout.event-blind-mode.de: Blind Event hides attendees from each other before the event. Turn it off when guests should be able to preview who is coming.
messages.guide.event.checkout.event-ticketing.des: Accepted attendees receive a QR ticket. An event manager can check it in once; this switch controls entry tickets, not the event price.
messages.guide.event.checkout.event-approval-requ: Auto approve off: join requests wait for an event admin. On: confirmed bookings can proceed without that manual approval.
messages.guide.event.checkout.event-source-link.d: This link gives guests an external information page. Use it for details that belong outside the event description.
messages.guide.event.checkout.event-mode-locked.d: This view shows the existing event mode. It cannot be changed here; the available stages follow that mode.
The mode determines how stages work: a programme, a scored competition, or rotating conversations. Choose it before defining the stages.
messages.guide.event.checkout.event-stage-view.tr: Timeline makes the running order easy to compare. Cards show individual stage details. Switching views does not change the programme.
messages.guide.event.checkout.event-title.label: Check the event before joining
messages.guide.event.checkout.event-title.descrip: The name identifies the event this request belongs to. Confirm that it is the intended programme before selecting attendance options.
messages.guide.event.checkout.event-location.desc: Check the event location before joining. A linked map helps you plan travel; opening it does not reserve attendance or transport.
messages.guide.event.checkout.event-description.d: Read the programme and practical expectations before requesting a place. This description belongs to the organizer’s event; checkout does not edit it.
messages.guide.event.checkout.event-definitions.d: Mandatory activities belong to the event programme. Optional activities can be selected through the basket; review their timing and availability.
messages.guide.event.checkout.event-date.label: Check start and end
messages.guide.event.checkout.event-date.descript: Review the event’s time range. If multiple slots are offered, the selected occurrence and its basket determine your requested attendance.
messages.guide.event.checkout.checkout-basket-edi: Opens the basket editor to select an offered slot and optional activities. This changes your draft selection; the final action submits the request.
messages.guide.event.checkout.checkout-basket-ite: This row is an attendance item in your basket. Check its date, included activities and price before continuing.
messages.guide.event.checkout.close.label: Leave the review
messages.guide.event.checkout.close.description: Closes this review without pressing its final confirmation. Check the event’s participation state separately; reviewing a basket alone does not approve attendance.
The plus selects this event and becomes a check. It does not open another popup or join the event; use the header check to return the selection.
messages.guide.community.group.editor.image-previ: The large preview shows the selected photo. Selecting another filled slot changes this preview; selecting it again opens replacement.
messages.guide.community.group.editor.image-uploa: Choose a file from your device for this empty slot. Wait for upload to finish; uploading a file does not save the whole profile or publish a feed post.
messages.guide.community.group.editor.image-repla: A filled slot first selects its photo. Click the selected slot again to choose a replacement; check the new preview before saving the parent editor.
Copies the image link to the clipboard. It does not duplicate the photo into another slot or save your profile.
messages.guide.community.group.editor.image-remov: Remove this photo from the draft
Removes this photo from the edited collection. Review the remaining images before saving the parent profile, event, asset or post.
messages.guide.community.group.editor.image-pages: The dots move between pages of photo slots. This only changes which slots are visible; it does not reorder or remove images.
messages.guide.community.group.editor.image-detai: Opens the photo’s caption and location or event link. A red pencil means its required event is missing: link an event before saving the feed post.
messages.guide.community.group.editor.image-locat: This location belongs to the photo. Keep it within 240 characters; longer text blocks saving its details.
messages.guide.community.group.editor.image-capti: Describe what the photo shows in up to 40 characters. The remaining count is a character limit, not a required minimum.
messages.guide.community.group.editor.image-detai: Applies these details to the current image draft. A required event must be selected and the location must fit the limit; save the parent editor separately.
messages.guide.notifications.close.label: Return without submitting
messages.guide.notifications.close.description: Closes this screen. Closing is separate from Save, sending a request or confirming a payment; use the relevant action when you intend to submit.

messages.guide.payment.history.close.description: Closes this screen. Closing is separate from Save, sending a request or confirming a payment; use the relevant action when you intend to submit.

messages.guide.event.resources.close.description: Closes this screen. Closing is separate from Save, sending a request or confirming a payment; use the relevant action when you intend to submit.
messages.guide.event.subevents.close.label: Return without submitting
messages.guide.event.subevents.close.description: Closes this screen. Closing is separate from Save, sending a request or confirming a payment; use the relevant action when you intend to submit.
messages.guide.event.explore.card-actions.follow-: Following adds this organizer to your followed list so you can find their events. Unfollowing removes that connection; neither action changes event attendance.
messages.guide.event.editor.event-stage-summary.d: Each card describes one activity or round. Its order, duration and offset determine how it fits into the event.
This badge shows the planned duration. It helps you check whether all stages fit inside the event dates.
messages.guide.event.editor.event-stage-kind.desc: Shows whether an activity is mandatory or optional. In Tournament and Mingle mode it identifies the stage or round instead.
messages.guide.event.editor.card-actions.label: Change a stage
messages.guide.event.editor.card-actions.descript: Edit opens this stage’s timing and participation rules. Delete removes its definition from the draft; review the schedule afterward.
messages.guide.event.editor.card-actions.edit.des: Opens a separate editor for this stage. Its timing, capacity and tournament rules belong to this stage, not the whole event.
messages.guide.event.editor.card-actions.delete.d: Removes this stage from the event draft. Check the remaining sequence and timing before saving the event.
messages.guide.event.editor.subevent-mode.trigger: Mandatory activities belong to the main event. Optional activities can have their own places and price. Tournament stages stay mandatory.
messages.guide.event.editor.subevent-save.label: Apply to the event draft
messages.guide.event.editor.subevent-save.descrip: Applies this stage to the event draft. Required fields must be valid; the event itself is persisted with its own Save action.
messages.guide.event.editor.stage-name.label: Recognizable activity name
messages.guide.event.editor.stage-name.descriptio: Participants use this name to distinguish activities or rounds. A name is required before this stage can be applied.
messages.guide.event.editor.stage-capacity.label: Places for this activity
messages.guide.event.editor.stage-capacity.descri: Sets the attendance range of this optional activity. Its capacity can differ from the main event’s capacity.
messages.guide.event.editor.stage-placement.label: Place in the sequence
messages.guide.event.editor.stage-placement.descr: Places this stage before, during or after the reference activity. The anchor and offset determine its relative timing.
messages.guide.event.editor.stage-anchor.label: Reference stage
messages.guide.event.editor.stage-anchor.descript: Choose the existing stage used for relative positioning. Together with placement and offset it anchors the new activity in time.
messages.guide.event.editor.stage-offset.label: Gap in the schedule
messages.guide.event.editor.stage-offset.descript: Adds a time offset in minutes to the relative schedule. Use it to leave room for a break or movement between activities.
messages.guide.event.editor.stage-description.des: Describe the activity or round and any preparation it needs. This required text helps guests decide what they are joining.
messages.guide.event.editor.stage-duration.label: Length of the activity
messages.guide.event.editor.stage-duration.descri: Reserves this many minutes for the stage. Changing it affects how the stage fits with the rest of the schedule.
messages.guide.event.editor.stage-date.label: Activity dates
messages.guide.event.editor.stage-date.descriptio: Sets the time window for this activity. Check it against the parent event’s dates and any other stages.
messages.guide.event.editor.stage-location.label: Where this activity happens
messages.guide.event.editor.stage-location.descri: This activity can have a more specific meeting point than the main event. Give participants enough detail to find it.
messages.guide.event.editor.stage-pricing.label: Optional activity price
messages.guide.event.editor.stage-pricing.descrip: Optional activities may have a separate price. Guests review the selected activities and their costs during checkout.
Mandatory activities do not have a separate activity price. Their cost belongs to the main event’s pricing.
messages.guide.event.editor.stage-group-min.label: Minimum group size
messages.guide.event.editor.stage-group-min.descr: Sets the lower size bound for tournament groups in this stage. Check it together with the maximum and available participants.
messages.guide.event.editor.stage-group-max.label: Maximum group size
messages.guide.event.editor.stage-group-max.descr: Limits the number of participants in each group. This bound also affects the estimated number of groups.
messages.guide.event.editor.stage-ranking.label: How standings are compared
messages.guide.event.editor.stage-ranking.descrip: Selects the leaderboard rule for this tournament stage. Choose a rule that matches how results will be recorded.
messages.guide.event.editor.stage-advance.label: Advancing from each group
messages.guide.event.editor.stage-advance.descrip: Sets how many participants advance from each group. Review this together with the capacity of the next stage.
This read-only estimate reflects the current capacity settings. It does not create groups; review the actual groups separately.
messages.guide.event.members.member-profile.label: View this person
messages.guide.event.members.member-profile.descr: Opens the profile details this person makes visible to you. Viewing a profile does not change their membership or role.
messages.guide.members.members-list.label: Member cards
messages.guide.members.members-list.description: Review people and roles for the group, asset or conversation named above. Membership state determines who can participate and which requests need a decision.
messages.guide.members.pending-only.label: Show pending requests
messages.guide.members.pending-only.description: Turn this filter on to focus on people whose requests are not resolved yet. Turn it off to return to the full member list.
messages.guide.members.invite.label: Invite participants
messages.guide.members.invite.description: Opens invitations for this group, asset or conversation. Review recipients before sending; opening the chooser does not send invitations.
messages.guide.members.members-close.label: Close member list
messages.guide.members.members-close.description: Returns to the screen that opened this member list. Closing the guide alone keeps the member list open.
messages.guide.members.card-actions.label: Actions for this person
messages.guide.members.card-actions.description: The menu applies to this person’s membership. Role and participation state determine which actions are available.
messages.guide.members.card-actions.member-involv: Shows the person’s participation across activities. Use it to understand their assignments before changing membership.
messages.guide.members.card-actions.member-toggle: Organizer only separates management from attendance. Count as participant includes this organizer in event participation.
messages.guide.members.card-actions.member-promot: Gives this member management permissions in the current group, asset or conversation. Review the scope before changing their role.
messages.guide.members.card-actions.member-revoke: Revocation removes this member’s manager role. Review the confirmation to distinguish role changes from removing participation.
messages.guide.members.card-actions.member-stepDo: Stepping down removes your management role in this context. It does not promote someone else in your place.
messages.guide.members.card-actions.member-approv: Accepts a pending membership request in this context. Check the person and the group or asset named above before confirming.
messages.guide.members.card-actions.member-remove: The effect depends on the current state: an invitation, request or existing membership may be removed. Read the confirmation before continuing.
Ends your membership in the current context. Review the confirmation for its effect on your access and any linked bookings.
messages.guide.members.card-actions.member-disqua: Disqualification changes this participant’s tournament status. Check the person and stage before confirming the exclusion.
messages.guide.members.card-actions.member-reinst: Reinstatement reverses this participant’s disqualified status where the current stage allows it. Review the confirmation before applying it.
messages.guide.members.card-actions.member-report: A report sends the described concern for review. It does not directly change the reported person’s role or participation.
messages.guide.members.card-status.label: Why participation is pending
messages.guide.members.card-status.description: Invitation pending: the guest must respond. Waiting for approval: an admin must decide. Waiting for payment: payment is unfinished. The icon also distinguishes member roles.
messages.guide.members.card-state-detail.label: Participation state
messages.guide.members.card-state-detail.descript: This label flags payment still due or a removed membership. The menu shows which actions are available in the current state.
messages.guide.members.member-profile.label: View this person
messages.guide.members.member-profile.description: Opens the profile details this person makes visible to you. Viewing a profile does not change their membership or role.
messages.guide.context.members.title: Members
messages.guide.context.members.description: Understand available actions in the current member list.
messages.guide.common.image-view.label: View the photos
messages.guide.common.image-view.description: Browse the available photos. If there is more than one page, use the arrows or page dots. This view does not change the images.
Switch between upcoming and earlier availability records. An empty current list can still have completed bookings under Earlier.
messages.guide.assets.availability.view.trigger.d: Choose how bookings are arranged in time. Calendar views help compare occupied periods; the list shows individual requests and assignments.
messages.guide.assets.availability.filter.trigger: All combines the activity types. Use the filter to focus on pending requests, borrowed items or event assignments before taking action.
messages.guide.assets.availability.day-list-filte: Filters records inside the selected date range. Changing the filter only changes the list; it does not accept or cancel a request.
messages.guide.assets.availability.day-list-date-: Sets which dates this list covers. Review overlapping usage here before accepting another request for the asset.
messages.guide.assets.availability.availability-l: Shows bookings, requests and assignments for this asset. Dates, quantity and state explain how each record affects availability.
messages.guide.assets.availability.availability-r: Review who uses the asset, for which activity and during which dates. Its menu acts on this record, not every use of the asset.
messages.guide.assets.availability.row-status.des: Pending still needs a decision. Borrowed means an accepted request; Assigned identifies an event assignment. The number is the reserved quantity.
messages.guide.assets.availability.card-actions.d: Available actions depend on your role and this record’s state. Management, approval and removal have different effects.
messages.guide.assets.availability.card-actions.m: Opens the management screen for this assignment. Inspect members, resource details and available actions there.
messages.guide.assets.availability.card-actions.a: Accepts this pending asset request. Check its dates, quantity and availability before confirming.
messages.guide.assets.availability.card-actions.r: Removes the selected request or assignment. Review the confirmation for any booking or payment consequences.
messages.guide.assets.availability.card-actions.m: Gives the person management rights for this assignment. Review who receives the role before confirming.
messages.guide.assets.availability.card-actions.r: Removes the person’s manager role for this assignment. This is separate from removing the request itself.
messages.guide.assets.availability.close.label: Return to the asset
messages.guide.assets.availability.close.descript: Closes this availability view. No request is accepted or removed by closing it.
messages.guide.context.assets.availability.title: Availability and requests
messages.guide.context.assets.availability.descri: Understand requests, assignments and their management actions.
messages.guide.assets.explore.asset-explore-order: Changes the order of the results without changing availability or sending a request. Choose the order that helps you compare suitable assets.
messages.guide.assets.explore.asset-explore-categ: Filters vehicles, accommodation or supplies. Availability is evaluated for the selected type and dates.
messages.guide.assets.explore.asset-explore-date-: These dates determine availability and pricing. Changing them can change which assets you can request.
messages.guide.assets.explore.asset-list.label: Available asset offers
messages.guide.assets.explore.asset-list.descript: Compare the owner, capacity, price and availability for the chosen dates. Opening a card does not reserve the asset.
messages.guide.assets.explore.card-badge-start.de: Opens the owner’s visible profile. It helps identify the provider before you request their asset.
messages.guide.assets.explore.card-badge-end.desc: Opens the borrow review when this asset is available. Check dates, quantity, price and policies before confirming a request.
messages.guide.assets.explore.card-static-state.d: An unavailable badge cannot open borrowing. Review the date range or another asset; availability can differ between periods.
messages.guide.assets.explore.borrow-basket.label: Resume a borrow draft
messages.guide.assets.explore.borrow-basket.descr: Keeps requests you started reviewing. Open one to continue; a saved draft alone is not a confirmed reservation.
messages.guide.context.assets.explore.title: Explore assets
messages.guide.context.assets.explore.description: Compare offers and prepare a borrow request.
messages.guide.payment.history.payment-history-ro: Read the amount, direction and date together. A refund has its own record; a failed attempt does not mean the payment was captured.
messages.guide.payment.history.row-status.label: Transaction state
messages.guide.payment.history.row-status.descrip: The state distinguishes captured, failed and refunded payments. A pending refund still needs a decision; it is not yet a completed repayment.
messages.guide.payment.history.card-actions.payme: Open the items and result of this transaction. This explains what the amount covered without starting a new checkout.
messages.guide.payment.history.card-actions.askOr: Open a conversation with the organizer about this payment. Sending a message is separate from requesting a refund.
messages.guide.payment.history.card-actions.askAs: Open a conversation with the asset owner about this payment or booking. A message alone does not cancel the booking or refund the payment.
messages.guide.payment.history.card-actions.reque: Review the eligible amount and applicable policy before confirming a request. Requesting does not mean the refund has already been approved or paid.
messages.guide.payment.history.card-actions.appro: Review the requested amount and policy before confirming. Approval starts the refund action, so check the affected payment carefully.
messages.guide.payment.history.card-actions.delet: Remove an incorrectly recorded cash receipt after confirmation. Deleting the record does not itself transfer money back to the payer.
messages.guide.payment.history.summary-currency.t: Choose the currency used to compare summary totals. Changing it does not change the original currency or amount of any payment.
messages.guide.payment.history.summary-currency-s: Apply this currency to your summaries. Close without saving to keep the previous display preference.
messages.guide.payment.history.payment-card.label: Saved payment method
messages.guide.payment.history.payment-card.descr: Check the provider, last digits and expiry to identify a card. Expired or disconnected methods must be removed or reconnected before they can be used.
messages.guide.payment.history.add-card.label: Register a card
messages.guide.payment.history.add-card.descripti: Open the payment provider’s registration flow. Complete it there before the new method becomes available for checkout.
messages.guide.payment.history.confirm-card.label: Use the selected card
messages.guide.payment.history.confirm-card.descr: Confirm which saved method this checkout will use. Selecting the method is separate from confirming the payment itself.
messages.guide.payment.history.payment-card-actio: Manage this saved payment method. The available options depend on whether the card is usable, expired or needs reconnection.
Start provider registration for a replacement method. Past payment records remain separate from the saved card.
Renew provider authorization for this method. Until reconnection completes, the disconnected card cannot be used for checkout.
Remove this method from future card choices after confirmation. This does not delete past payment records or request a refund.
messages.guide.activities.rates.rating-save.label: Save this rating
messages.guide.activities.rates.rating-save.descr: Press this button to save the selected value for the current card. Moving the slider only prepares the value; Save confirms your change.
messages.guide.context.landing.home.title: Getting started
messages.guide.landing.home.login.label: Your own account
messages.guide.landing.home.login.description: Sign in to keep your own profile and activity. The demo uses sample identities; it does not register a personal account.
messages.guide.landing.home.explore.label: Try a sample profile
messages.guide.landing.home.explore.description: Explore opens the demo selector. Choose a role and a sample person to see the app from their perspective; a new profile lets you try setup.
messages.guide.landing.home.join.label: Start your own profile
messages.guide.landing.home.join.description: Joining opens the available sign-in flow. Device permissions and installation are separate choices; creating an account does not install the app.
messages.guide.context.landing.setup.title: Device setup
messages.guide.landing.setup.location.label: Location and nearby access
messages.guide.landing.setup.location.description: Location is used for nearby results and login availability. Selecting it prepares the request; your browser still asks for permission when you apply the settings.
messages.guide.landing.setup.notifications.label: Notifications on this device
messages.guide.landing.setup.notifications.descri: Enable notifications to receive updates outside the open app. Availability depends on this device, browser and deployment; a disabled control cannot request permission.
messages.guide.landing.setup.permissions-save.des: Apply sends the selected permission requests to the browser. A blocked permission must be changed in site settings; pressing again cannot override a browser denial.
messages.guide.landing.setup.install.label: Install a home-screen shortcut
messages.guide.landing.setup.install.description: Installation opens this app in its own window and adds an icon. It does not create an account or grant permissions. This action appears only when the device supports it.
messages.guide.context.landing.demo.title: Choose a demo identity
messages.guide.landing.demo.new-profile.label: Try registration
messages.guide.landing.demo.new-profile.descripti: Start with a new sample profile to try the setup form. Required fields and photos must be completed before saving; this remains a demo identity.
messages.guide.landing.demo.selector-role.trigger: The role selector changes which sample identities are listed. It does not grant a real account extra permissions; each demo identity opens its own workspace.
Members use profiles, groups, events and shared assets. Choose this role to try the everyday experience and see how your choices affect the sample account.
messages.guide.landing.demo.selector-role.admin.d: Admin identities open the administration workspace. Their tools manage the demo’s content and settings; they are separate from the ordinary member view.
messages.guide.landing.demo.selector-role.operato: Operator identities open deployment-level tools. Choose one to inspect the operator workflow; this is distinct from member activity and content administration.
messages.guide.landing.demo.member-card.label: Open this sample account
messages.guide.landing.demo.member-card.descripti: The whole card is a button. Selecting it starts a demo session as that person; their profile, roles and existing activity determine what you will see.
messages.guide.context.landing.auth.title: Sign in or register
messages.guide.landing.auth.providers.label: Choose a sign-in method
messages.guide.landing.auth.providers.description: Use an available provider or email. Keep using the same method for the same account; unavailable providers cannot start sign-in.
messages.guide.landing.auth.account-mode.label: Existing or new account
messages.guide.landing.auth.account-mode.descript: Login opens an existing email account. Create registers a new one and requires password confirmation; switching mode does not submit the form.
messages.guide.landing.auth.email.label: An email you can access
messages.guide.landing.auth.email.description: Use your own email address so you can return to this account. Check it before submitting; it identifies the account for email sign-in.
messages.guide.landing.auth.password.label: Choose a private password
messages.guide.landing.auth.password.description: Enter the account password. For a new account, follow the displayed rules; the eye button reveals the text locally so you can check it.
messages.guide.landing.auth.password-rules.label: Requirements before registration
messages.guide.landing.auth.password-rules.descri: The rule list shows which checks still fail. Correct the missing requirements and make both passwords identical before creating the account.
messages.guide.landing.auth.confirmation.label: Confirm the same password
messages.guide.landing.auth.confirmation.descript: Repeat the new password exactly. A mismatch prevents registration and helps avoid creating an account with a mistyped password.
messages.guide.landing.auth.submit.label: Submit when ready
messages.guide.landing.auth.submit.description: This button sends the selected login or registration request. Creating an account may be followed by profile setup; permission and installation choices remain separate.
messages.guide.context.landing.registration.title: Complete your profile
messages.guide.landing.registration.form-progress: The progress indicator shows where you are. Red marks identify missing required information; moving to another section does not save the profile.
messages.guide.landing.registration.full-name.des: Enter the name shown on your profile. Required fields must be filled before saving; the red marker clears once the field meets its validation rules.
messages.guide.landing.registration.birthday.desc: Your age is derived from this date. Enter the actual date rather than an age number; an invalid or missing required date blocks saving.
messages.guide.landing.registration.city.label: Your profile’s city
messages.guide.landing.registration.city.descript: Choose the city associated with your profile. This profile detail is separate from granting the browser access to your current device location.
messages.guide.landing.registration.gender.label: Profile and matching information
messages.guide.landing.registration.gender.descri: Select the option that describes you. This becomes part of your profile and can influence which profiles are shown by other users’ filters.
messages.guide.landing.registration.languages.des: Choose languages you can communicate in. Other people can use this information to find suitable conversations; it does not change the app’s interface language.
messages.guide.landing.registration.images.label: Required profile photos
messages.guide.landing.registration.images.descri: Add at least three profile images. Each filled slot contributes to the requirement; removing too many images makes the profile incomplete and blocks saving.
messages.guide.landing.registration.form-navigati: Use the arrows to reach photos, further details and the review. Required fields on other pages still count, so check all red markers before saving.
messages.guide.landing.registration.form-save.des: Save submits the profile after all required checks pass. A disabled or red action means something still needs attention; review the marked fields and photos.
messages.guide.landing.setup.help.label: Device-specific instructions
messages.guide.landing.setup.help.description: The question mark explains browser and phone differences, including blocked permissions. Open it if your device does not offer the expected permission or install prompt.
messages.guide.landing.registration.height.label: Height in centimetres
messages.guide.landing.registration.height.descri: Enter a positive height in centimetres. This required profile detail can be used by filters; an empty or invalid value prevents completing this section.
messages.guide.landing.registration.physique.labe: A profile attribute used in filters
messages.guide.landing.registration.physique.desc: Choose the body-type option that describes you. This is a required profile field, so leaving the selector empty keeps this section incomplete.
messages.guide.event.feedback.form-progress.label: Required answers on this card
messages.guide.event.feedback.form-progress.descr: The counter follows the event and participant cards. Red marks missing required answers on the current card; complete them before moving forward.
messages.guide.event.feedback.feedback-primary.de: Choose one answer about the event or person shown above. Each card keeps its own answers, so check whose feedback you are filling in.
A second aspect of the experience
Choose one response to this card’s follow-up question. It is required independently of the overall answer and adds context to your feedback.
messages.guide.event.feedback.feedback-traits.des: Select one to three traits that fit your experience. Tap a selected trait again to remove it; at least one is required before continuing.
messages.guide.event.feedback.feedback-comment.de: Add up to 160 characters about the event. This field is optional and appears on the event card, so leaving it empty does not block the next step.
messages.guide.event.feedback.form-navigation.des: The arrow opens the next card once required answers are complete. Your answers stay in this form; only Submit feedback on the overview sends them.
messages.guide.event.feedback.form-save.label: Submit all answers together
messages.guide.event.feedback.form-save.descripti: Review the event and participant answers, then submit them together. Missing required answers block submission; use the previous arrow to return and correct them.
messages.guide.common.pair-score-received.label: A received pair score
messages.guide.common.pair-score-received.descrip: This is the score attached to a pair suggestion you received. It is read-only here: use the paging arrow to browse more suggestions without saving a rating.
messages.guide.common.pair-images.label: Each side has its own photos
messages.guide.common.pair-images.description: Tap a section of either photo to switch that person’s image independently. Three photos give thirds; four give quarters. A side with just one photo has no switch.
messages.guide.common.pair-profiles.label: Open either person’s profile
messages.guide.common.pair-profiles.description: Each eye opens the profile on its own side. Close that popup to return to this pair. Viewing a profile does not change a rating or accept a suggestion.
messages.guide.common.pair-score-summary.label: Your current pair rating
messages.guide.common.pair-score-summary.descript: The middle badge shows this pair’s current score. In fullscreen it is a summary; use the slider and Save below to change it. The list’s badge opens the editor.
messages.guide.home.game.rating-details.label: Fine-tune the rating
messages.guide.home.game.rating-details.descripti: Open the number and arrow button beside Go. Adjust the individual criteria; their average sets your rating. The main slider moves them together. Close the panel, then confirm with Go.
messages.guide.activities.rates.rating-details.de: The detailed rating belongs to the evaluated card domain. Dating, a pair, a campaign, a Work profile and service interest use their own criteria; completed-service feedback remains separate.

messages.guide.community.services.service-list: Create a service with +, then publish it. Drafts and trash are visible only to their owner. When selecting a provider for a case, + picks the service; choose the assigned worker when it has several staff members.
messages.guide.community.service.editor.service-d: Describe what you offer. Images are optional. Service radius uses profile coordinates. Pricing describes the appointment policy; saving a service does not charge anyone.
messages.guide.community.service.editor.service-s: Reuse the slot editor to define recurring times and date overrides. Staff are selected with the member picker. A worker must also accept the case invitation before customers can book.
messages.guide.community.service.calendar.provide: Day, week and month views show your appointments across services and cases. Open the related case or cancel an appointment from its menu. Other case participants receive the change notification.
messages.guide.community.case.appointments.appoin: Use the existing calendar and + basket to choose times with the assigned provider, then save. The same worker cannot be booked at overlapping times in another service or case. Removing your selection cancels that appointment.
messages.notification.kind.payment-transfer-recei: A member recorded receiving your bank transfer. The amount and note appear in your payment history.
messages.guide.payment.history.counterparty.label: Filter by member
messages.guide.payment.history.counterparty.descr: Open the member list and use + to select one member. Confirm an empty selection to show All. The filter changes the list while your overall payment totals stay available.

messages.guide.work.campaigns.campaign-list.label: Campaign cards
messages.guide.work.campaigns.campaign-list.descr: The image and short summary introduce each campaign. The card color identifies its category. Details contain the full description and documents.
messages.guide.work.campaigns.close.label: Close

messages.guide.work.campaign.select.close.label: Close
messages.guide.work.campaign.select.close.descrip: Close this list and return to the previous screen.
messages.guide.work.campaigns.status:trigger.desc: Switch between Published, Draft and Deleted in the header. A campaign moves to the corresponding list after its action succeeds.
messages.guide.work.campaigns.create.label: Create a campaign
messages.guide.work.campaigns.create.description: Create a draft with images, title, description, opportunity type, category and optional documents. Publish it from the card menu when ready.
messages.guide.work.campaigns.card-actions.label: Campaign actions
messages.guide.work.campaigns.card-actions.descri: Use the three-dot menu for details, editing, Ratings and publication actions. This is the management menu for your campaign.
messages.guide.work.campaigns.card-actions:edit.d: Change the campaign text, pictures or documents, then save.
messages.guide.work.campaigns.card-actions:campai: Open Activities with this campaign already selected as its scope. The ordinary Ratings entry shows averages across campaigns.
messages.guide.work.campaigns.card-actions:publis: Make the saved campaign available in discovery.
messages.guide.work.campaigns.card-actions:unpubl: Remove the campaign from discovery while retaining it for editing. Confirm the action in the dialog.
Move the campaign to Deleted after confirmation.
messages.guide.work.campaigns.card-actions:restor: Restore a deleted campaign for further management.
messages.guide.work.campaign.select.card-media-ac: Use the upper-right plus to select a campaign. The check mark identifies the current choice. This picker contains published campaigns only.
messages.guide.work.campaign.select.basket.label: Selected campaign
messages.guide.work.campaign.select.basket.descri: Review or remove the selected campaign before confirming.
messages.guide.work.campaign.select.confirm.label: Use selection
messages.guide.work.campaign.select.confirm.descr: Apply the selection to the event editor. An event without a campaign uses aggregate rating priorities.
messages.guide.work.campaign.editor.images.label: Pictures
messages.guide.work.campaign.editor.images.descri: Upload pictures or open the existing gallery. Choose a clear first image: it is the campaign card cover.
messages.guide.work.campaign.editor.title.label: Name
messages.guide.work.campaign.editor.title.descrip: Give the campaign a short, specific name that explains the opportunity.
messages.guide.work.campaign.editor.description.d: Explain the purpose, who you want to meet and what the next conversation would cover. Only a short excerpt appears on the card.
messages.guide.work.campaign.editor.kind.label: Opportunity type
messages.guide.work.campaign.editor.kind.descript: Choose work, business or both. This classification appears on management cards and in discovery filters.
messages.guide.work.campaign.editor.category.desc: Choose the subject area. This controls the category filter and the card color.
messages.guide.work.campaign.editor.attachments.d: Select several documents with plus. Editing lists their names separated by commas; the saved details show a table with download actions.
messages.guide.work.campaign.editor.attach.label: Attach files
messages.guide.work.campaign.editor.attach.descri: Choose up to ten documents in total. Wait for upload completion before saving. The attachment menu can remove individual files.
messages.guide.work.campaign.editor.save.label: Save

messages.guide.work.campaign.history.history-camp: Expand a campaign to read its full description and documents. You can open and close each block independently.
messages.guide.work.campaign.history.view:trigger: Details is selected initially. Switching to Organizer retains the loaded history and expanded blocks for your return.

messages.integration.access.title: Connection access
messages.integration.access.blocked.description: This connection cannot read or write personal or workspace data.
messages.integration.access.write.description: Supported creation and organizing changes, such as events, campaigns, community cases and invitation links. Returns only the results needed for the operation.
messages.integration.access.full.description: Read plus MCP Events: receive updates about resources you choose to monitor. Requires an approved MCP connection and a compatible AI client.
messages.integration.access.mcp.limit: An MCP client is limited by both its own pack and the main MCP link. Events requires Full on both. API keys do not receive MCP Events.
messages.integration.access.draft.hint: Save with the tick in the previous window.
messages.integration.access.save.failed: Permissions could not be saved. Your changes remain here; retry saving.
messages.integration.access.conflict: The connection settings changed meanwhile. Close and reopen this window, then apply your changes again.
messages.integration.mutation.failed: The connection change failed. Please retry.
messages.guide.context.profile.integration-access: Choose the access level and confirm the draft.
API and MCP permissions stay within the selected profile’s existing rights.
messages.guide.profile.integrations.integration-t: The shield opens four packs: Blocked, Write, Read and Full. Read includes Write and permitted queries. Events only works through OAuth MCP, not an API key. Confirm stages the choice; the parent tick saves it.
messages.guide.profile.integrations.mcp-main-acce: The main link starts Blocked and caps every MCP client of this profile. Enable and save it deliberately. Read permits queries without Events. Full is needed here and on the client for requested background monitoring.
messages.guide.profile.integrations.mcp-client-ac: Set this client independently. Its effective access is the lower of this choice and the main MCP setting. A Full client cannot receive Events while the main link is Read, Write or Blocked.
messages.guide.profile.integrations.integration-a: The tick appears when permissions change. It saves all staged API and MCP levels together and closes this window after success. Closing with X discards unsaved permission changes.
messages.guide.profile.integration-access.integra: Choose a complete pack: red Blocked, amber Write, blue Read or green Full. The shield and label follow the draft. Read includes Write; Full additionally permits MCP Events. No per-operation switches are needed.
The tick appears when the level differs from the opening value. It closes this popup and updates the parent draft. Save that parent draft to persist the change.
messages.guide.profile.integration-access.close.d: Close without confirming to keep the parent draft unchanged.
