messages.guide.chat.call.call-participants.label: Participants
messages.guide.chat.call.call-participants.descri: Each tile belongs to one participant. Swipe or use the arrows for more people. Offscreen video pauses while their audio continues.
messages.guide.chat.call.call-follow-speakers.des: Turn this on to keep the current and most recent speakers visible. Turn it off to choose a page yourself.
messages.guide.chat.call.call-self-mute.label: Your microphone
messages.guide.chat.call.call-self-mute.descripti: Mute or restore your microphone here or with the bottom microphone button. Red means muted. An admin mute must first be released by an admin.
messages.guide.chat.call.call-self-camera.label: Your camera
messages.guide.chat.call.call-self-camera.descrip: Switch your own camera on or off. This matches the bottom camera button and the camera in your volume block. Audio can stay on.
messages.guide.chat.call.call-peer-mute.label: Mute one person for yourself
messages.guide.chat.call.call-peer-mute.descripti: Mute this participant only on your device. Others still hear them. Their volume-panel mute controls the same setting.
messages.guide.chat.call.call-peer-video.label: Receive this video
messages.guide.chat.call.call-peer-video.descript: Stop or restore video from this participant to save bandwidth. Audio continues. This matches their camera control in the volume panel.
messages.guide.chat.call.call-admin-mute.label: Mute for everyone
messages.guide.chat.call.call-admin-mute.descript: As an admin, mute this participant for the whole call. Releasing the restriction lets them switch their own microphone back on; it does not turn it on for them.
messages.guide.chat.call.call-zoom.label: Enlarge a participant
messages.guide.chat.call.call-zoom.description: Show one tile at full size. Press again to return to the grid. Other participants remain audible.
messages.guide.chat.call.call-spectrum.label: Speech activity
messages.guide.chat.call.call-spectrum.descriptio: The bars show the microphone sound level across frequencies. The green microphone and frame show speech; a red crossed microphone means muted.
messages.guide.chat.call.call-accept.label: Join with audio
messages.guide.chat.call.call-accept.description: Join this call with your microphone. Your camera starts off and can be enabled later.
messages.guide.chat.call.call-decline.label: Decline the call
messages.guide.chat.call.call-decline.description: Decline this invitation without starting your microphone or camera. The chat remains available.
messages.guide.chat.call.call-microphone.label: Microphone on or off
messages.guide.chat.call.call-microphone.descript: Choose whether others can hear you. This does not mute incoming sound. The red button and your tile show when you are muted.
messages.guide.chat.call.call-camera.label: Camera on or off
messages.guide.chat.call.call-camera.description: Choose whether to send your camera picture. You can keep talking with the camera off.
messages.guide.chat.call.call-volume.label: Volume and received video
messages.guide.chat.call.call-volume.description: Open playback volume and individual participant controls. Each named block lets you adjust sound or stop receiving that person’s video.
messages.guide.chat.call.call-play-audio.label: Allow audio playback
messages.guide.chat.call.call-play-audio.descript: Your browser paused incoming audio. Press this button to allow playback on this device.
messages.guide.chat.call.call-hangup.label: Leave the call
messages.guide.chat.call.call-hangup.description: Leave the call and release your microphone and camera. The chat stays open and the others can continue talking.
messages.guide.chat.call.close.label: Close and leave
messages.guide.chat.call.close.description: Closing this call window also leaves the call. Closing only the explanation guide does not leave it.

messages.guide.chat.call.volume.self-camera.label: Your camera
messages.guide.chat.call.volume.self-camera.descr: This switches your own camera, just like the bottom camera button and the icon on your tile. It does not switch everyone’s video.
messages.guide.chat.call.volume.peer-volume.label: This person’s volume
messages.guide.chat.call.volume.peer-volume.descr: Adjust the participant named above this slider. The setting combines with your overall playback volume and does not affect other listeners.
messages.guide.chat.call.volume.peer-mute.label: Mute this person
messages.guide.chat.call.volume.peer-mute.descrip: Mute only this participant on your device. Unmuting keeps their previous volume. Their tile microphone shows the same setting.
messages.guide.chat.call.volume.peer-video.label: This person’s video
messages.guide.chat.call.volume.peer-video.descri: Stop or allow their video on your device; their audio stays on. Allowing it resumes video when their tile is visible.
messages.guide.chat.call.volume.close.label: Close the volume panel

messages.guide.operator.updates.overview.label: Updates
messages.guide.operator.updates.overview.descript: Check the installed version, offered release and rollback target before acting. During an update this window shows the current phase, progress and any failure.
messages.guide.operator.updates.operator-refresh-: Fetch the latest release information and update state. This checks what is available; installation starts only with the update action.
messages.guide.operator.updates.operator-apply-up: Start installing the offered release on this deployment. Follow its progress here; after successful completion the application reloads to use the installed version.
messages.guide.operator.updates.operator-rollback: Start the supported rollback to the displayed target version. Check that target first; a successful rollback reloads the application just like an update.
messages.guide.operator.updates.close.label: Close
messages.guide.operator.updates.close.description: Close the progress window and return to the operator page. Closing this window does not cancel an update already started.
messages.guide.context.operator.updates.title: Updates
messages.guide.context.operator.updates.summary: Compare installed and available versions; progress and errors appear here.
messages.guide.context.operator.updates.descripti: Compare installed and available versions; progress and errors appear here.
messages.guide.operator.registration.overview.des: Check the selected Registry address, registration state, last heartbeat and measurement delivery together. A registered connection does not by itself mean every report has been delivered.
messages.guide.operator.registration.register.des: Register at the Registry address entered here. If it differs from the active Registry, the existing binding is replaced; verify the destination before starting.
messages.guide.operator.registration.disconnect.d: Deactivate this deployment’s current Registry connection. Use this when you intend to disconnect, rather than merely close the registration window.
messages.guide.operator.registration.synchronize-: Request delivery of pending measurement reports to the connected Registry. Check the returned delivery state to distinguish accepted reports from those still pending or blocked.
messages.guide.operator.registration.refresh.desc: Reload registration, heartbeat and delivery information after an operation or connection change. Refreshing the view does not register or disconnect the deployment.
messages.guide.operator.registration.close.label: Close
messages.guide.operator.registration.close.descri: Return to the operator page. The registered connection remains active; use Disconnect when you intend to deactivate it.
messages.guide.context.operator.registration.summ: Review registration, heartbeat and measurement delivery for this deployment.
messages.guide.context.operator.registration.desc: Review registration, heartbeat and measurement delivery for this deployment.
messages.guide.operator.claim.overview.label: Operator claim
messages.guide.operator.claim.overview.descriptio: Choose company verification for a new operator identity, or a client code to join an existing one. Registration is required before submission; pending review and approval are shown separately.
messages.guide.operator.claim.operator-claim-path: Prepare the company’s legal details and the authorized representative’s contact information. Submitting sends these for verification; filling the form alone does not approve the operator.
Use a client code issued by an already verified, active operator to link this deployment to that operator. This is the joining path, not a new company-verification request.
messages.guide.operator.claim.operator-claim-lega: Enter the company’s registered legal name so the verification can identify the legal entity. Use the company details here, rather than the product’s display name.
messages.guide.operator.claim.operator-claim-atte: Confirm that you are authorized to represent the named legal entity. This declaration is required for the company request; it does not replace the verification decision.
messages.guide.operator.claim.operator-redeem-tok: Submit the entered client code to link this registered deployment to its issuing operator. Read the resulting status to check whether the link was accepted.
messages.guide.operator.claim.close.label: Close
messages.guide.operator.claim.close.description: Return to the operator page. Closing does not submit the form or withdraw a request that has already been sent for review.
messages.guide.context.operator.claim.title: Operator claim
messages.guide.context.operator.claim.summary: Choose company verification or an existing client code. The current review state is shown here.
messages.guide.context.operator.claim.description: Choose company verification or an existing client code. The current review state is shown here.
messages.guide.operator.configuration.overview.de: Expand a section to edit deployment settings. Branding, access and service credentials share a configuration draft, so review other pending edits before saving; TLS has its own save operation.
messages.guide.operator.configuration.operator-sa: Save the name and logo used by this deployment. This saves the shared configuration draft, including pending edits in its other sections; the updated branding is then applied in the app.
Save the email list that grants app-administration access. Check additions and removals carefully; this also saves other pending changes in the shared configuration draft.
Save the data controller’s name and privacy contact email shown in the app’s privacy information. Other pending edits in the shared configuration draft are saved with them.

Save the Firebase configuration, then run its authentication and messaging checks before activation. Saving credentials and activating them are separate actions; other shared configuration edits are also saved.
Submit the selected TLS mode, domain and certificate settings. Follow the returned job state to confirm completion; a save request alone does not prove the new certificate is already active.
messages.guide.operator.configuration.close.label: Close
messages.guide.operator.configuration.close.descr: Return to the operator page. Use the relevant save action before closing if you want to persist pending configuration changes.
messages.guide.context.operator.configuration.sum: Open a section to configure branding, administrators, privacy contacts and service connections. Save changes in that section.
messages.guide.context.operator.configuration.des: Open a section to configure branding, administrators, privacy contacts and service connections. Save changes in that section.
messages.guide.operator.revenue.overview.label: Revenue
messages.guide.operator.revenue.overview.descript: Compare revenue entries with delivery status and accepted settlements for the displayed period and currency. A locally recorded amount and a Registry-accepted report represent different stages.
messages.guide.operator.revenue.operator-synchron: Ask the delivery queue to synchronize pending revenue reports. Inspect the resulting state and blocked reports afterwards; starting synchronization does not guarantee that every report is accepted.
messages.guide.operator.revenue.close.label: Close
messages.guide.operator.revenue.close.description: Return to the operator page. Closing the revenue view leaves recorded entries, settlements and report-delivery state intact.
messages.guide.context.operator.revenue.title: Revenue
messages.guide.context.operator.revenue.summary: Review the ledger, settlement state and report delivery. Amounts follow the displayed currency and period.
messages.guide.context.operator.revenue.descripti: Review the ledger, settlement state and report delivery. Amounts follow the displayed currency and period.
messages.guide.operator.community.overview.label: Operator community
messages.guide.operator.community.overview.descri: Read announcements shared with operators, including attached links and download-verification information. Check the source and the displayed verification state before using a download.
messages.guide.operator.community.close.label: Close
messages.guide.context.operator.community.title: Operator community
messages.guide.context.operator.community.summary: Read the operator community information and available announcements here.
messages.guide.context.operator.community.descrip: Read the operator community information and available announcements here.
messages.guide.operator.deployments.overview.desc: Inspect the deployments belonging to the operator you selected in the leaderboard. Compare their reported status and contribution to understand how that operator’s total is composed.
messages.guide.operator.deployments.close.label: Close
messages.guide.context.operator.deployments.title: Operator deployments
messages.guide.context.operator.deployments.summa: These nodes belong to the selected operator. Inspect their reported status and contribution.
messages.guide.context.operator.deployments.descr: These nodes belong to the selected operator. Inspect their reported status and contribution.
messages.guide.admin.home.overview.label: Administration
messages.guide.admin.home.overview.description: Open the avatar menu to choose a task: content review, user reports, feedback, jobs or monitoring. Each opens its own workspace; personal notifications and guide visibility are controlled from the same menu.
messages.guide.context.admin.home.title: Administration
messages.guide.context.admin.home.summary: Open your avatar menu to choose moderation, content, jobs or monitoring. Notification and guide controls are also there.
messages.guide.context.admin.home.description: Open your avatar menu to choose moderation, content, jobs or monitoring. Notification and guide controls are also there.
Open a row to inspect the submitted content, then use its menu to record a review decision. The status and category filters determine which items remain visible after a decision.
messages.guide.admin.content-moderation.status.de: Choose the review state to work on. Counts reflect the selected category; changing this filter only changes the list, while a row’s decision menu changes the item’s state.
Limit the queue to a content type, such as posts, events or assets. Combine it with the status filter to find the items that need your review in this workspace.
Set whether moderation is enabled for this workspace, which categories it covers and whether automatic approval is used. Changes are prepared in a separate form and require saving.
messages.guide.context.admin.content-moderation.s: Review submitted content and apply a decision within your current workspace.
messages.guide.context.admin.content-moderation.d: Review submitted content and apply a decision within your current workspace.
messages.guide.admin.moderation-settings.overview: Choose the moderated categories and whether automatic approval is enabled. If you use automatic approval, set its delay; check all selections before saving the workspace settings.
messages.guide.admin.moderation-settings.save.des: Persist the selected moderation settings for this workspace and return to its review queue. If saving fails, the form stays open so you can correct or retry the change.
messages.guide.admin.moderation-settings.close.de: Discard this settings draft and return to the review queue. To apply changed categories or automatic-approval settings, save before closing.
Configure automatic review and enabled moderation categories, then save.
Configure automatic review and enabled moderation categories, then save.
messages.guide.admin.reports.overview.label: Reports
messages.guide.admin.reports.overview.description: Open a report to read its reason, affected user and source context. Use the user’s action menu for a warning or restriction after reviewing the evidence; opening a report alone does not take that action.
messages.guide.admin.reports.reports-review-statu: Switch between unresolved reports that need attention and resolved reports you want to revisit. This selects the queue; it does not change a report’s review state.
messages.guide.admin.reports.blocked-users.label: Blocked accounts
messages.guide.admin.reports.blocked-users.descri: Open the restricted-user list to inspect existing blocks. A user’s menu offers unblocking and, when a support conversation already exists, access to that conversation.
messages.guide.admin.reports.close.label: Close
messages.guide.context.admin.reports.title: Reports
messages.guide.context.admin.reports.summary: Open a report to inspect its evidence and available review actions.
messages.guide.context.admin.reports.description: Open a report to inspect its evidence and available review actions.
messages.guide.admin.report-detail.overview.label: Review report
messages.guide.admin.report-detail.overview.descr: Read the report’s reason and linked context alongside the reported user. Review the source before using the available warning or block action; the action applies to that user.
messages.guide.admin.report-detail.close.label: Close
messages.guide.context.admin.report-detail.title: Review report
messages.guide.context.admin.report-detail.summar: Read the report and its context before choosing a review action.
messages.guide.context.admin.report-detail.descri: Read the report and its context before choosing a review action.
messages.guide.admin.blocked-users.overview.label: Blocked accounts
messages.guide.admin.blocked-users.overview.descr: Review who is blocked and when the restriction was recorded. Use the row menu to lift a block after confirmation, or open an existing support conversation to understand its context.
messages.guide.admin.blocked-users.close.label: Close
messages.guide.context.admin.blocked-users.title: Blocked accounts
messages.guide.context.admin.blocked-users.summar: Inspect restrictions and use the available account actions.
messages.guide.context.admin.blocked-users.descri: Inspect restrictions and use the available account actions.
messages.guide.admin.feedback.overview.label: Feedback
messages.guide.admin.feedback.overview.descriptio: Read submitted bug reports, requests and other feedback. After handling an item, use its row menu to mark it solved; a solved item can be returned to unresolved when further work is needed.
messages.guide.admin.feedback.feedback-review-sta: Choose unresolved feedback for current work or solved feedback for follow-up. Marking an item solved changes which queue contains it; it does not delete the submission.
messages.guide.admin.feedback.close.label: Close
messages.guide.context.admin.feedback.title: Feedback
messages.guide.context.admin.feedback.summary: Open a feedback item to read it and record its review state.
messages.guide.context.admin.feedback.description: Open a feedback item to read it and record its review state.
messages.guide.admin.feedback-detail.overview.des: Read the full submission and its category before deciding whether it has been handled. Return to the feedback list to use the row’s solved or unresolved action.
messages.guide.admin.feedback-detail.close.label: Close
messages.guide.context.admin.feedback-detail.summ: Read the submitted feedback and choose the appropriate review action.
messages.guide.context.admin.feedback-detail.desc: Read the submitted feedback and choose the appropriate review action.
messages.guide.admin.chat-review.overview.label: Chat review
messages.guide.admin.chat-review.overview.descrip: Review the selected user and report context before composing a warning. Sending records a moderation warning for that user; it is an action, not a private draft note.
messages.guide.admin.chat-review.message.label: Warning text
messages.guide.admin.chat-review.message.descript: Write the warning the selected user will receive: identify the reported conduct and explain what needs to change. Check the recipient and wording before sending.
messages.guide.admin.chat-review.send-warning.des: Send the written warning to the selected user, linked to the selected report when present. Wait for the success message; after a successful send the text field is cleared.
messages.guide.admin.chat-review.close.label: Close
messages.guide.context.admin.chat-review.title: Chat review
messages.guide.context.admin.chat-review.summary: Inspect the selected report conversation. A warning sends your message to the affected user.
messages.guide.context.admin.chat-review.descript: Inspect the selected report conversation. A warning sends your message to the affected user.
messages.guide.admin.item-preview.overview.label: Reported item
messages.guide.admin.item-preview.overview.descri: Inspect the reported item’s actual content and attachments before making a moderation decision. Close this preview to return to the report and its available actions.
messages.guide.admin.item-preview.close.label: Close
messages.guide.context.admin.item-preview.title: Reported item
messages.guide.context.admin.item-preview.summary: Inspect the reported item before returning to its review.
messages.guide.context.admin.item-preview.descrip: Inspect the reported item before returning to its review.
messages.guide.admin.help-editor.overview.label: Content editor
messages.guide.admin.help-editor.overview.descrip: Maintain help and policy documents, and guides that allow editing. Choose a language, save a revision and activate it when ready for users. Application-managed system guides are excluded from this editor.
messages.guide.admin.help-editor.help-document.de: Select the document type or editable guide you intend to maintain. For an explanation, also check its target screen so the saved steps belong to the right part of the app.
messages.guide.admin.help-editor.help-language.de: Choose the content language before editing. Each language has separate revisions and an active version, so changing this selection does not translate or publish the other language.
messages.guide.admin.help-editor.help-new-revisio: Prepare a new revision of the selected document and language. Save it first, then activate the revision when it should replace the version users currently see.
messages.guide.admin.help-editor.close.label: Close
messages.guide.context.admin.help-editor.title: Content editor
messages.guide.context.admin.help-editor.summary: Manage help, policy and editable guide revisions. System guides are maintained with the application and are hidden here.
messages.guide.context.admin.help-editor.descript: Manage help, policy and editable guide revisions. System guides are maintained with the application and are hidden here.
messages.guide.admin.idea-editor.overview.label: Articles
messages.guide.admin.idea-editor.overview.descrip: Manage article drafts, published articles and trash in the selected language. Editing saves the content; publication and featured placement are separate actions on the article card.
messages.guide.admin.idea-editor.idea-filter.desc: Choose drafts for unfinished work, published or featured articles for visible content, or trash to recover a removed article. The filter changes the list without publishing or deleting anything.
messages.guide.admin.idea-editor.idea-language.de: Select which language’s articles to list and edit. Check this before creating a draft or changing text so the content is saved for the intended readers.
messages.guide.admin.idea-editor.idea-new.label: New article
messages.guide.admin.idea-editor.idea-new.descrip: Start a new article in the selected language. Prepare its title, text and images, preview it, then save; publication is a separate action on the saved article.
messages.guide.admin.idea-editor.close.label: Close
messages.guide.context.admin.idea-editor.title: Articles
messages.guide.context.admin.idea-editor.summary: Manage articles, drafts and published content in the selected language.
messages.guide.context.admin.idea-editor.descript: Manage articles, drafts and published content in the selected language.
messages.guide.admin.article-view.overview.label: Article preview
messages.guide.admin.article-view.overview.descri: Check the article’s text, images and layout as a reader would see them. A draft preview lets you review pending edits; opening it does not save or publish them.
messages.guide.admin.article-view.close.label: Close
messages.guide.context.admin.article-view.title: Article preview
messages.guide.context.admin.article-view.summary: Review the article as displayed to readers. Close to return to the editor.
messages.guide.context.admin.article-view.descrip: Review the article as displayed to readers. Close to return to the editor.
messages.guide.admin.article-edit.overview.label: Edit article
messages.guide.admin.article-edit.overview.descri: Edit the article for the selected language, including its title, text and images. Preview the result before saving, and use the saved article’s separate publication action when ready.
messages.guide.admin.article-edit.article-save.de: Persist this article’s current text and media, then return to the list. Saving a new draft does not publish it; the article card provides the publication action.
messages.guide.admin.article-edit.article-preview: Open a reader-style preview of the current draft, including edits not yet saved. Close the preview to continue editing, then save to keep those changes.
messages.guide.admin.article-edit.close.label: Close
messages.guide.admin.article-edit.close.descripti: Close the editor and discard its unsaved draft. Save first if you want to keep the current text and media changes.
messages.guide.context.admin.article-edit.title: Edit article
messages.guide.context.admin.article-edit.summary: Edit the article and review its preview before saving.
messages.guide.context.admin.article-edit.descrip: Edit the article and review its preview before saving.
messages.guide.admin.notifications.overview.label: Jobs and notifications
messages.guide.admin.notifications.overview.descr: Inspect automated processes and notification rules, including their state, timing and run history. Open a row for its controls; personal received notifications are in your notification inbox.
messages.guide.admin.notifications.process-filter: Narrow the process list to the category you need to inspect. Filtering helps locate a job or delivery rule; it does not enable, disable or start that process.
messages.guide.admin.notifications.close.label: Close
messages.guide.context.admin.notifications.title: Jobs and notifications
messages.guide.context.admin.notifications.summar: Manage delivery rules, schedules and job runs. This is separate from your personal notification inbox.
messages.guide.context.admin.notifications.descri: Manage delivery rules, schedules and job runs. This is separate from your personal notification inbox.
messages.guide.admin.process-detail.overview.desc: Check the selected process’s configuration and recent runs before changing it. Timing and parameter controls are available only where that process supports them; run history helps distinguish configuration from execution results.
messages.guide.admin.process-detail.process-detai: Persist the edited process configuration. Check the save result before leaving; saving configuration is separate from a manual run of the process.
messages.guide.admin.process-detail.close.label: Close
messages.guide.context.admin.process-detail.title: Job details
messages.guide.context.admin.process-detail.summa: Review channels, parameters and recent runs before changing the rule.
messages.guide.context.admin.process-detail.descr: Review channels, parameters and recent runs before changing the rule.
messages.guide.admin.schedule-edit.overview.label: Schedule
messages.guide.admin.schedule-edit.overview.descr: Set the selected process’s supported start time, interval or run windows. Review the resulting timing before saving, because it controls when the scheduled process becomes due.
Save the selected process’s timing and return to its details. This updates its schedule; use the separate run action if you intend to execute it manually.
messages.guide.admin.schedule-edit.close.label: Close
messages.guide.admin.schedule-edit.close.descript: Cancel this timing edit and restore the schedule shown when you opened the editor. Save before closing if the new timing should take effect.
messages.guide.context.admin.schedule-edit.title: Schedule
messages.guide.context.admin.schedule-edit.summar: Set when the selected job runs, including its interval or start time.
messages.guide.context.admin.schedule-edit.descri: Set when the selected job runs, including its interval or start time.
messages.guide.admin.job-parameter.overview.label: Job parameter
messages.guide.admin.job-parameter.overview.descr: Review the selected process’s parameter names, values and offered choices. Edit the values needed for its operation, then save to persist the configuration.
messages.guide.admin.job-parameter.parameter-save: Save the edited job parameters and return to the process. These values configure its operation; saving them does not itself request a manual run.
messages.guide.admin.job-parameter.close.label: Close
messages.guide.admin.job-parameter.close.descript: Discard this parameter draft and return to the process. Use Save first to retain the edited values.
messages.guide.context.admin.job-parameter.title: Job parameter
messages.guide.context.admin.job-parameter.summar: Edit the selected job parameter and save the change.
messages.guide.context.admin.job-parameter.descri: Edit the selected job parameter and save the change.
messages.guide.admin.params.overview.label: Application parameters
messages.guide.admin.params.overview.description: Expand a configuration section to inspect its current values. Edit changes that section; History shows its recorded versions and offers restoration of an earlier version.
messages.guide.admin.params.close.label: Close
messages.guide.context.admin.params.title: Application parameters
messages.guide.context.admin.params.summary: Inspect current configuration, edit a parameter or view its history.
messages.guide.context.admin.params.description: Inspect current configuration, edit a parameter or view its history.
messages.guide.admin.parameter-edit.overview.desc: Edit the selected section’s fields using the displayed values, units and choices. Saving applies the section as a new configuration change; closing without saving discards this draft.
messages.guide.admin.parameter-edit.save-edit.des: Save all edited fields in this configuration section. The saved state replaces the displayed current values and the editor closes after success.
messages.guide.admin.parameter-edit.close.label: Close
messages.guide.admin.parameter-edit.close.descrip: Cancel the section edit and discard unsaved field changes. Already saved configuration remains in effect.
messages.guide.context.admin.parameter-edit.title: Edit parameter
messages.guide.context.admin.parameter-edit.summa: Check the value and its validation before saving.
messages.guide.context.admin.parameter-edit.descr: Check the value and its validation before saving.
messages.guide.admin.parameter-history.overview.d: Expand a version to inspect its saved values and change information. Restoring an earlier version changes the active configuration; inspecting a version alone leaves the current values in effect.
messages.guide.context.admin.parameter-history.su: Review earlier changes and their authors.
messages.guide.context.admin.parameter-history.de: Review earlier changes and their authors.
messages.guide.admin.stats.overview.label: Statistics
messages.guide.admin.stats.overview.description: Read the summary metrics together with their period and segments, then use the timelines to compare changes. The graph help explains network measures so counts and relationships can be interpreted in context.
messages.guide.admin.stats.stats-refresh.label: Refresh
messages.guide.admin.stats.stats-refresh.descript: Reload the statistical snapshot for the current view. Check the displayed period and update information before comparing refreshed figures with earlier observations.
messages.guide.admin.stats.close.label: Close
messages.guide.context.admin.stats.title: Statistics
messages.guide.context.admin.stats.summary: Explore the displayed period and metrics. Use chart help for the selected graph.
messages.guide.context.admin.stats.description: Explore the displayed period and metrics. Use chart help for the selected graph.
messages.guide.admin.graph-help.overview.label: Chart explanation
messages.guide.admin.graph-help.overview.descript: Use the explanations of edges, bridges, reach, clustering and recurring connections to interpret the network charts. Return to the chart to compare those definitions with the displayed values.
messages.guide.admin.graph-help.close.label: Close
messages.guide.context.admin.graph-help.title: Chart explanation
messages.guide.context.admin.graph-help.summary: This explanation describes the selected chart and how to read it.
messages.guide.context.admin.graph-help.descripti: This explanation describes the selected chart and how to read it.
messages.guide.admin.affinity-graph.overview.desc: Explore the displayed people and their affinity links. Drag with the left mouse button to pan, use the right button to rotate and the wheel to zoom; consult the legend when comparing nodes.
messages.guide.admin.affinity-graph.close.label: Close
messages.guide.context.admin.affinity-graph.title: Affinity graph
messages.guide.context.admin.affinity-graph.summa: Inspect the graph and its displayed relationships.
messages.guide.context.admin.affinity-graph.descr: Inspect the graph and its displayed relationships.
messages.guide.admin.monitoring.overview.label: Monitoring
messages.guide.admin.monitoring.overview.descript: Follow the operational flow cards to locate unhealthy components, queued work or delivery problems. Read each stage’s metrics and the volumes between stages together before choosing what to investigate.
messages.guide.admin.monitoring.monitoring-filter: Focus on items needing attention, domain activity, delivery or workers. The filter selects monitoring categories; it does not alter the monitored processes.
messages.guide.admin.monitoring.close.label: Close
messages.guide.context.admin.monitoring.title: Monitoring
messages.guide.context.admin.monitoring.summary: Review operational measurements and recent application activity.
messages.guide.context.admin.monitoring.descripti: Review operational measurements and recent application activity.
messages.guide.admin.payment-simulator.overview.d: Open the configured payment simulator’s administration view to inspect and change its test setup. Check the provider and settings in that view before running the payment scenario you want to exercise.
messages.guide.context.admin.payment-simulator.su: Inspect simulated payment outcomes and use the provided test controls.
messages.guide.context.admin.payment-simulator.de: Inspect simulated payment outcomes and use the provided test controls.
messages.guide.admin.payment-authorizations.overv: This opens the configured payment simulator’s authorization view. Inspect the displayed payment details before using its decision controls, then check the resulting authorization state.
messages.guide.context.admin.payment-authorizatio: Review pending payment authorizations and decide only after checking their details.
Review pending payment authorizations and decide only after checking their details.
messages.guide.admin.navigation.notifications.des: Open notifications directly. Use the existing mute control in the notification popup to hide or restore the floating alert. Notifications and unread counts are kept.
messages.guide.admin.navigation.explanations.desc: Switch guides off or on. Both floating buttons can be dragged to a convenient position.
messages.guide.admin.navigation.settings.label: Settings
messages.guide.admin.navigation.settings.descript: Open language, policy, help and sign-out actions.
messages.guide.admin.navigation.adminModeration.d: Open the content-review queue to inspect submissions by type and status, then record moderation decisions. Its settings control the categories and automatic approval used in the workspace.
messages.guide.admin.navigation.adminReports.desc: Review reports about users with their reason and source context. After inspecting the evidence, use the available actions to warn or restrict the affected user.
messages.guide.admin.navigation.adminFeedback.des: Read bug reports, feature requests and other feedback. Mark handled submissions solved, or reopen them for further work, without deleting their content.
messages.guide.admin.navigation.adminChat.label: Chat review
messages.guide.admin.navigation.adminChat.descrip: Open the moderation conversation view for the selected reported user. Check the report context and recipient before writing and sending a warning.
messages.guide.admin.navigation.adminJobs.label: Jobs
messages.guide.admin.navigation.adminJobs.descrip: Inspect background processes, notification rules and recent runs. Open a process to manage its supported timing and parameters or use its execution controls.
messages.guide.admin.navigation.adminParams.label: Parameters
messages.guide.admin.navigation.adminParams.descr: Inspect and edit application configuration by section. Each section’s history lets you compare recorded versions and restore an earlier configuration when needed.
messages.guide.admin.navigation.adminContent.desc: Maintain help, policies and editable guides by language and revision. Save prepared content, then activate the version users should see; system-managed guides are excluded.
messages.guide.admin.navigation.adminArticle.desc: Create and revise articles, preview their content, and manage publication or featured placement from the cards. Drafts and trash remain available through the list filters.
messages.guide.admin.navigation.adminStats.label: Statistics
messages.guide.admin.navigation.adminStats.descri: Compare profile and activity statistics across the displayed periods and segments. Use timelines and graph explanations to interpret changes in the figures.
messages.guide.admin.navigation.adminMetrics.desc: Inspect operational health, processing stages and delivery volumes. Use the attention filter to focus the view on components that need investigation.
messages.guide.admin.navigation.adminGraph.label: Graph
messages.guide.admin.navigation.adminGraph.descri: Explore people and affinity links in an interactive graph. Pan, rotate and zoom the view to inspect connections while using the legend to interpret nodes.
messages.guide.admin.navigation.adminPaymentSimul: Open the configured payment simulator’s settings to prepare a payment test. The simulator view controls the test setup used by the selected payment provider.
messages.guide.admin.navigation.adminPaymentAutho: Open the payment simulator’s authorization view to inspect the payments presented there and use its decision controls. Check payment details before submitting a decision.
messages.guide.context.admin.navigation.title: Administration menu
Open notifications directly. Use the existing mute control in the notification popup to hide or restore the floating alert. Notifications and unread counts are kept.

messages.mcp.events.title: Background monitoring · MCP Events
messages.mcp.events.help: Set the main MCP link and the chosen client to Full and save. In the AI client, specify what to monitor and what to do when it changes: for example, watch an event you organize for Mingle results. Events also supports changes to your assets. The client subscribes after your request; enabling Full alone does not start monitoring. Ask the client to stop monitoring, lower either pack or revoke the connection to stop delivery. Missed updates are not replayed. Ratings, votes and personal decisions remain yours in the app.
messages.mcp.events.availability: Events support, subscription plans and workspace permissions depend on the AI provider. ChatGPT documents Events in Work chats on the web and in desktop Cloud mode. Ordinary MCP connectivity, including Claude connectors, does not by itself prove Events support. MyScoutee does not check your AI subscription.

messages.integration.roles.summary: Admin and operator connections are read-only. Read enables permitted statistics; Full adds role alerts through MCP Events.
messages.integration.roles.help: Use your role profile’s API/MCP settings. An administrator can read the existing profile/registration statistics and attention counts. An operator can read paged measurement and revenue reports. Full MCP access can signal new registrations, admin reports/feedback or operator releases. The client may read the authorized summaries after a signal; it cannot moderate, approve updates, synchronize reports, pay or change configuration. Current role membership is checked again for requests and deliveries. The existing desktop admin key keeps its overview endpoint.
